a: Mishna en podin lo beegel velo bechayya, lo bishchuta velo bitrefa, velo bechilayim velo bechoy. verabbi eliezer mattir bakkilayim mippene shehu se, veoser bakkoy mippene shehu safek. netano lechohen — en hakkohen rashshay lekayyeymo ad sheyyafrish se tachtav.
Gemara matnitin manni? ben bag bag hi, detanya: ben bag bag omer: neemar kan "se", veneemar lehallan "se", ma lehallan perat lechol hashshemot hallalu, af kan perat lechol hashshemot hallalu.
I ma lehallan zachar tamim uven shana, af kan zachar tamim uven shana? talmud lomar: "tifde" "tifde" — ribba.
I "tifde" "tifde" ribba, afillu kol hane name? im ken, "se" "se" may ahani leh?

Ibbaya lehu: mahu lifdot beven pekua? allibba derabbi meir la tibbee lach, dechevan deamar rabbi meir: ben pekua taun shechita, se mealleya hu. ella ki tibbee lach allibba derabbanan, deamri: shechitat immo metaharto.
Kevisra bedikkula dame, o dilma: kevan dehashta miha rahet veazel, "se" karena beh?
Mar zutera amar: en podin, verav ashe amar: podin.
Amar leh rav ashe lemar zutera: may dataych? deyalfat mippesach. i ma lehallan zachar tamim uven shana, af kan zachar tamim uven shana! "tifde" "tifde" — ribba.
I "tifde" "tifde" ribba, afillu ben pekua name! im ken, "se" "se" may ahani leh?
Ibbaya lehu: mahu lifdot benidma? allibba derabbi eliezer la tibbee lach, hasheta bechilayim parkinan, benidma mibbaya?
Ki tibbee lach allibba derabbanan, bechilayim hu dela parkinan, benidma parkinan, o dilma la shena?
Ta shema: para sheyyalda min ez — en podin, ha rachel sheyyalda min ez — podin. manni? ilema rabbi eliezer — ha bechilayim name parkinan! ella lav rabbanan hi?
La, leolam rabbi eliezer hi, gufa ka mashma lan defara sheyyalda min ez — en podin. la tema: zil abbatreh dideh, vehay ez mealleya hu, ella zil batar immeh — vehay egel hu.

Ta shema, detane rabba bar shemuel: ezehu kilayim? rachel sheyyalda min ez, veaviv se. aviv se, kilayim hu? nidme hu! ella, ezehu dame lechilayim, deshavveyu rabbanan ki chilayim? rachel sheyyalda min ez, veaviv se.
Lemay? i lekadashim — mehecha dimmaet kilayim, mehatam memaet nidme, detanya: "shor o chesev" — perat lechilayim, "o ez" — perat lenidme!
I livchor, "ach bechor shor" amar rachamana, ad sheyyehe hu shor uvechoro shor!
Ella lemaaser, "tachat" "tachat" mikkodashim gamar! ella lefeter chamor.
La, leolam lemaaser, uchegon sheyyesh bo miktzat simanin, mahu detema "haavara" "haavara" mibbechor gamar,
Ka mashma lan, "tachat" "tachat" mikkodashim gamar.
Ibbaya lehu: mahu lifdot bifsule hammukedashin?
Allibba derabbi shimon la tibbee lach, kevan deamar muttar bahanaa — chullin hu, ki tibbee lach allibba derabbi yehuda deamar asur bahanaa.
May? kevan deasur bahanaa, en issur chal al issur?
O dilma, kevan dela tafes pidyono, afkoe issura bealma hu?
Amar rav mari bereh derav kahana: mi zutar may dichtiv behu, "katztzevi vechaayyal"? ma tzevi veayyal en podin, af pesule hammukedashin en podin!
Hasheta deatet lehachi,
b: Lerabbi shimon name, "tzevi veayyal" ketiv behu.
Ibbaya lehu: mahu lifdot bevehemat sheviit?
Vadday — la tibbee lach, laachila amar rachamana, velo lischora. ki tibbee lach — safek.
Veallibba derabbi shimon la tibbee lach, delet leh safek, ki tibbee lach allibba derabbi yehuda.
May kevan demafresh tale vehu leatzmo, "leochla" karena beh, o dilma: kevan dechamma dela mafka issureh la mishtere, kischora dame?
Ta shema, deamar rav chisda: behemat sheviit en podin bah et havvadday, aval podin bah et hassafek.
Veamar rav chisda: behemat sheviit petura min habbechora, vechayyevet bammattanot.
Petura min habbechora — "leochla" amar rachamana, velo lisrefa, vechayyevet bammattanot — dilachla" karena ba.
Metivi: haochel meissat sheviit ad shello hurema challatah — chayyayv mita.
Veammay? kevan deillu mittammeya bat serefa hi, "leochla" amar rachamana, velo lisrefa!
Shane hacha, dichtiv "ledorotechem".
Tanya name hachi: minnayin laochel meissat sheviit ad shello hurema challatah shechayyayv mita — shenneemar: "ledorotechem".
Veligmar minna! hatam ikkar laachila, hacha ikkar lisrefa.
Netano lechohen kulei. tenena leha detanu rabbanan: yisrael shehaya lo peter chamor betoch beto, veamar lo hakkohen: "tenehu li vaani efdehu" — hare ze lo yittenu lo, ella im ken pedao befanav.

Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: zot omeret nechshedu hakkohanim al pitre chamorim. peshita! mahu detema: hane mille hecha demachzak lan demikkere, aval bistama la — ka mashma lan demore ba hettera.
Mishna hammafrish pidyon peter chamor vamet, rabbi eliezer omer: chayyayvin beachrayuto, kachamesh selaim shel ben, vachachamim omrim: en chayyayvin beachrayuto, kefidyon maaser sheni.

Heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi tzadok al pidyon peter chamor shemmet, sheen kan lakkohen kelum. met peter chamor, rabbi eliezer omer: yikkaver, umuttar bahanaato shel tale. vachachamim omrim: en tzarich lehikkaver, vetale lakkohen.
Gemara amar rav yosef: may tama derabbi eliezer? dichtiv: "ach pado tifde vegomer", ma bechor adam chayyayv beachrayuto, af bechor behema temea chayyayv beachrayuto.
Amar leh abbaye: i ma bechor adam muttar bahanaa, af bechor behema temea muttar! vechi tema hachi name, vehatnan: met peter chamor, rabbi eliezer omer: yikkaver. may yikkaver? lav deasur bahanaa?
La, yikkaver kivchor adam. ella, adam bechor hu devae kevura, pashut la bae kevura?
Veod tanya: mode rabbi eliezer beyisrael sheyyesh lo sefek peter chamor betoch beto — shemmafrish tale alav, vehu shello!
Ella amar rava: amar kera "ach pado tifde", lifdiyyay hikkashytiv, velo ledavar acher.
Tenan hatam: haarachin — bishatan, ufidyon habben — achar sheloshim yom, pidyon peter chamor — lealtar.
Ufidyon peter chamor lealtar? ureminhi: en baarachin, uvefidyon habben, uvinzirut, uvefeter chamor — pachot mishsheloshim.
Umosifin ad olam!
Amar rav nachman: lomar sheim pedao — paduy, mikkelal divno im pedao eno paduy? vehaittemar: happode et beno betoch sheloshim yom, rav amar: beno paduy!
Lav ittemar ala, amar rava: dechulle alma "meachshav" — en beno paduy.

a: Rav sheshet amar: lomar sheeno over alav.
Metiv rame bar chama: mitzvato kol sheloshim yom, mikkan veelach — o podehu o orfo. may lav mitzva leshahoto kol sheloshim yom? la, mitzva lifdoto kol sheloshim yom.
I hachi, "mikkan veelach o podehu o over alav" mibbee leh! ella amar rava: la kashya, ha rabbi eliezer demakkeshoy, ha rabbanan dela makkeshi.
Mishna lo ratza lifdoto — orfo meachorav vekovro. mitzvat happediyyay kodemet lemitzvat arifa, shenneemar: "im lo tifde vaarafto".
Mitzvat yeida kodemet lemitzvat happediyyay, shenneemar: "asher lo yeadah vehefdah".
Mitzvat hayyibbum kodemet lemitzvat chalitza, barishona shehayu mitkavvevnin leshem mitzva, veachshav sheen mitkavvevnin leshem mitzva, amru: mitzvat chalitza kodemet lemitzvat yibbum.
Mitzvat haggeulla baadon, hu kodem lechol adam, shenneemar: "veim lo yiggael venimkar beerkecha".
Hadaran alach hallokeach ubbar chamoro.

Mishna hallokeach ubbar parato shel nochri, vehammocher lo, af al pi sheeno rashshay, vehammishtattef lo, vehamekabbel mimmennu, vehannoten lo bekabbala — patur min habbechora, shenneemar "beyisrael", aval lo baacherim.
Hakkohanim vehaleviyyim chayyayvim, shello nifteru mibbechor behema tehora, ella mippidyon habben umippeter chamor.
Gemara may irya detane ubbar chamoro beresha, vahadar tane ubbar parato? litne beresha ubbar parato, dikdushshat hagguf hu, vahadar litne ubbar chamoro, dikdushshat damim hu.
Amri bemareva: ibbaet ema, ayyeyde dachaviva leh, kidrabbi chanina, vei baet ema, ayyeyde dezuteran milleh divhema temea, pasek veshade la.

Amar rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi oshaya: yisrael shennatan maot legoy bivhemto bedinehem, af al pi shello mashach — kana, vechayyevet bivchora. vegoy shennatan maot leyisrael bivhemto bedinehem, af al pi shello mashach — kana, ufatur min habbechora.
Amar mar: yisrael shennatan maot legoy bedinehem, af al pi shello mashach — kana vechayyevet bivchora.
May "bedinehem"? i nema bedinehem degufeh, deate bekal vachomer: im gufeh kane leh yisrael bechesef, dichtiv "lareshet achuzza",
Hikkisho hakkatuv laachuzza, ma achuzza niknet bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka, af eved kenaani nikne bechesef. mamono — lo kol shekken hu?
Im ken, afillu bishtar uvachazaka name! veod, yisrael miyyisrael yochichav, degufeh kane leh bechesef, mamono bimshicha!
Ella amar abbaye: bedinehem sheppaska lahem tora, "o kano miyyad amitecha" — miyyad amitecha hu devimshicha, ha miyyad goy bechesef.
Veema: miyyad goy — kelal kelal la! amri: la salka datach, kal vachomer hu — im gufo kone, mamono lo kol shekken?
Veema: miyyad goy — ad deikka tarte! amri: velav kal vachomer hu? gufo beachat, mamono bishtayim?! veema: o beha o beha, dumeya daamitecha".
Ma "amitecha" bachada, af goy name bachada.

Amar mar: vegoy shennatan maot leyisrael bivhemto bedinehen, af al pi shello mashach — kana, ufatur min habbechora. may bedinehen? illema bedinehen degufeh, mishshum deate bekal vachomer: im gufo yisrael kane leh bechesef, dichtiv "mikkesef miknato", mamono lo kol shekken?
Yisrael miyyisrael yochichav, degufo kane bechesef, mamono bimshicha! ella amar abbaye: bedinehem sheppaska lahem tora, "vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha" — laamitecha bimshicha, ha legoy bechesef.
Veema: legoy kelal kelal la! amri: lav kal vachomer hu? im gufo kana, mamono lo kol shekken?
Ema: legoy ad deikka tarte! lav kal vachomer hu? gufo beechad, mamono bishtayim?!
Veema: o beha o beha, dumeya daamitecha";
b: Ma "amitecha" beachat, af goy name beachat.
Amri: uleamemar deamar meshicha begoy kona, hanicha i savar la kerabbi yochanan deamar: devar tora maot konot, meshicha lo, ahani "laamitecha" — laamitecha bechesef, legoy bimshicha.
Ella i savar la keresh lakish, deamar: meshicha meforeshet min hattora, laamitecha bimshicha, ulegoy bimshicha, "laamitecha" lema li?
Amri: laamitecha atta machzir onaa, vei atta machazir onaa legoy. legoy — meal tonu ish et achiv" nafka!
Chad begoy, vechad behekdesh, utzerichi, dei ketav rachamana chad — hava amena: legoy hu deen lo onaa, aval hekdesh — yesh lo onaa, ka mashma lan.

Hanicha leman deamar gezelo asur — hayeynu deitzterich kera lemishre onaa, ella i savar la keman deamar gezelo shel goy muttar, onaa mibbaya? amri: i savar la keman deamar gezelo muttar — al kurechaych kerabbi yochanan sevira leh.
Metivi: hallokeach gerutaot min haggoyim, umatza bahen avoda zara — im ad shello natan maot mashach — yachazir, veim mishshennatan maot mashach — yolich hanaa leyam hammelach.
Vei amrat maot konot, meshicha lema li? hacha bemay askinan — shekkibbel alav ladun bedine yisrael. i hachi, maot lema li? hachi kaamar: af al pi shennatan maot, i mashech — in, vei la — la.
I hachi, kashya resha! amar abbaye: resha mishshum deikka mikkach taut. amar leh rava: resha mishshum deikka mikkach taut, sefa lekka mikkach taut?
Ella amar rava: resha vesefa mikkach taut, resha dela yahev zuze — la michze kaavoda zara beyad yisrael, sefa deyahev zuze — michze kaavoda zara beyad yisrael.
Veabbayye amar lach: resha mikkach taut, dela yada, deha la yehayv leh zuze. sefa lav mikkach taut hu, dechevan dihayv zuze, ki ka mashech — ibbei leayyone vahadar mimshach.
Rav ashe amar: midderesha meshicha enah kona, sefa name meshicha enah kona, veayyeyde ditna resha "mashach", tena sefa name "mashach".
Ravina amar: middesefa meshicha kona, resha name meshicha kona, veresha hachi kaamar: im lo natan velo mashach — yachzor. may yachzor? yachzor bidvarim.
Kasavar: devarim yesh bahem mishshum mechussere amana, vehane mille — yisrael miyyisrael, dekayymi bedibburayyhu, aval yisrael miggoyim, deinhu la kayymi bedibburayyhu — la.

a: Mishna kol hakkodashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu — chayyayvin babbechora uvammattanot, veyotzin lechullin liggazez veleaved, veladan vachalavan muttar leachar pidyonan.
Vehashshochatan bachutz patur, veen osin temura, veim metu — yippadu, chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser.

Vechol shekkadam hekdeshan et muman, o mum over lehekdeshan, uleachar mikkan nolad lahen mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu — peturin min habbechora umin hammattanot, veenan yotzin lechullin liggazez veleaved.
Veladan vachalavan asur leachar pidyonan, vehashshochatan bachutz chayyayv, veosin temura, veim metu — yikkaveru.
Gemara tama denifdu, ha lo nifdu — peturin min habbechora umin hammattanot. kasavar: kedushshat damim medacha min habbechora umin hammattanot.
Veyotzin lechullin vechulei. tama denifdu, ha lo nifdu — asiri begizza vaavoda. mesayyay leh lerabbi eliezer, deamar: kodshe bedek habbayit asurin begizza vaavoda?
Amri: la, kedushshat damim lammizbeach hu demichallefa bikdushshat hagguf lammizbeach, gezaru behu rabbanan, aval kodshe bedek habbayit — la.
Veladan vachalavan muttar kulei. hechi dame? illema deiabbar veityelid leachar pidyonan — peshita, chullin ninhu! ella deiabbar lifne pidyonan, veityelid leachar pidyonan.
Ha lifne pidyonan — asiri.
b: Nifdin temimim o en nifdin temimin?
Ta shema: hammatpis baale mumin kevuin legabbe mizbeach, veyaldu — yimmachru, veen tzerichin mum, sheen kedushsha chala alehen, shello yehe tafel chamur min haikkar.
Tama, shello yehe tafel chamur min haikkar, aval hikdish zachar ledamav — kadosh kedushshat hagguf. mesayyay leh lerava, deamar rava: hikdish zachar ledamav — kadosh kedushshat hagguf.
Vehashshochatan bachutz patur. rabbi elazar matne "chayyayv", umoke la bevamat yachid.

Deamar rabbi elazar: minnayin lazzoveach behema baalat mum bevamat yachid bishat hetter habbamot, shehu belo taase? shenneemar: "lo tizbach laAdonai elohecha shor vase", im eno inyan levama gedola, dichtiv: "avveret o shavur vegomer", tenehu inyan levamat yachid.
Ema: im eno inyan lekadashim — tenehu inyan livchor, salka datach amena: hoil vekadosh keshehu baal mum — likrav name keshehu baal mum, ka mashma lan dela!
Amri: bechor behedya ketiv beh "pisseach o ivver lo tizbachennu".
Veema: im eno inyan lekadashim — tenehu inyan lemaaser, desalka datach amena: hoil vekadosh bemumo, dichtiv: "lo yevakker ben tov lara", nikrav name bemumeh, ka mashma lan dela!
Amri: maaser name gamar "haavara" "haavara" mibbechor.
Ema: tenehu inyan litmurat kadashim, desalka datach amena: hoil ukedosha keshehi baalat mum, dichtiv: "lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto vegomer", kareva name keshehi baalat mum, ka mashma lan dela!
Amar kera: "vehaya hu utemurato", makkish temurato lo — ma hu baal mum lo, af temurato baal mum lo.
Matkef la rabbi zera: ema, tenehu inyan levaldot kadashim, desalka datach amena: hoil ukedoshin keshehen baale mumin aggav imman, keshehen baale mumin name karvi, ka mashma lan dela!

Amar rava: kevar paska tanna deve rabbi yishmael, detana deve rabbi yishmael: "rak kadashecha asher yihyu lecha unedarecha" — "rak kadashecha" ellu hattemurot, "asher yihyu lecha" ellu havvevladot, "unedarecha" — hikkishan hakkatuv leneder, ma neder baal mum lo, af hane name baal mum lo.
Veen osin temura, may tama? deamar kera: "lo yachalifennu velo yamir vegomer". hasheta ra betov amrat lo, tov bera mibbaya? ella tov meikkaro ose temura, ra meikkaro en ose temura.
Im metu yippadu. amar rav yehuda amar rav: zo divre rabbi shimon, deamar: kodshe mizbeach hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, kodshe bedek habbayit lo hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha.
Ditnan, rabbi shimon omer: kodshe bedek habbayit, im metu — yippadu. umode rabbi shimon bevaal mum meikkaro shennifde. may tama? deamar kera: "otah" "otah" — lemaote baal mum meikkara.
Aval chachamim omrim: im metu — yikkaveru. man chachamim? tana deve levi hu, detana deve levi: hakkol hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, vaafillu baal mum meikkaro.
Vechen tana deve levi bematniteh: afillu chayya, afillu of, vehachtiv "otah"! "otah" letana deve levi kashya.
Aval rabbanan difligi aleh derabbi shimon, may? hachi name deim metu yippadu? i hachi,

a: "Zo divre rabbi shimon umachluketo" mibbaya leh!

Amri: rav kerabbi shimon ben lakish, deamar lerabbanan: kodshe bedek habbayit hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, kodshe mizbeach lo hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, vela mittokma matnitin kerabbanan, dekatane sefa: veim metu yikkaveru.
Amar: mimmay deha "metu yikkaveru" mishshum devae haamada vehaaracha hu? dilma mishshum deen podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim hu! amri: im ken, nitne: "im naasu terefa yikkaveru".
Veibbaet ema: leolam rav kerabbi yochanan sevira leh, uteni: zo divre rabbi shimon umachluketo.
Aval kadam hekdeshan vechulei. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "tzevi", ma tzevi patur min habbechora, af pesule hammukedashin peturin min habbechora.
Otzi ani et habbechora, velo otzi et hammattanot? talmud lomar: "ayyal", ma ayyal patur min habbechora umin hammattanot, af pesule hammukedashin peturin min habbechora umin hammattanot.
I ma tzevi veayyal chelban muttar, af pesule hammukedashin chelban muttar? talmud lomar: "ach" — chillek.
Amar mar: otzi et habbechor, velo otzi et hammattanot. may shena otzi et habbechor — sheen shave bakkol, velo otzi et hammattanot — sheshshavot bakkol. talmud lomar: "ayyal".
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: i ma tzevi veayyal, en oto veet beno noheg bahen, af pesule hammukedashin en oto veet beno noheg bo!
Amar leh: lemay medammet lehu? i lechullin — "oto veet beno" noheg bo, vei lekadashim — "oto veet beno" noheg bo!
Amar leh: i hachi, gabbe chelbo name nema hachi: lemay medammet lehu? i lechullin — chelban asur, vei lekadashim — chelban asur!
Ella, lav mi amrat "ach" velo chelban? emar name "ach" velo oto veet beno.
Rava amar: "ach" leoto veet beno hu daata, vechelbo middamo" nafka, dichtiv: "rak et damo lo tochel".
May "damo"? illema damo mammash, la yehe ella daman ditzvi veayyal, attu daman ditzvi veayyal mi shere? ella "damo" — chelbo.
Velichtov rachamana "chelbo"! i ketav rachamana "chelev", hava amena: ahani hekkesha veahani kera.
Ahani hekkesha lemaote mikkaret, dechi ketav karet — aochel chelev behema hu dichtiv, shenneemar: "ki chol ochel chelev min habbehema".
Veahani kera lemekam aleh belav bealma, lehachi appekeh rachamana bilshon "damo", lomar lach: ma damo becharet — af chelbo becharet.
Veha tana "ach", velo chelbo, kaamar!
Hachi kaamar: illu lo neemar "damo", hayiti omer "ach" — velo chelbo, achshav shenneemar "damo", leoto veet beno hu daata.
Veenan yotzin lechullin. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "tizbach" — velo gizza, "basar" — velo chalav, "veachalta" — velo lichlavecha, mikkan sheen podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim.
b: Ikka deamri: "tizbach veachalta" — en lach bahen hetter achila ella mishsheat zevicha veelach, aval podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim, hachi name deamar.

Uveladan vachalavan asur leachar pidyonan. hechi dame? illema deiabbar veityelid leachar pidyonan — ammay? velad tzevi veayyal ninhu! ella deiabbar lifne pidyonan veityelid leachar pidyonan. ha lifne pidyonan — mikdash name kadshi.
Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "zachar" — lerabbot et havvalad, unekeva" — lerabbot et hattemura.
Veen li ella velad temimin utemurat temimim, veladoy baale mumin utemurat baale mumin minnayin? keshehu omer "im zachar" — lerabbot velad baale mumin, "im nekeva" — lerabbot temurat baale mumin.
Otan veladot shelleachar pidyonan, ma tehe alehen? lifne pidyonan — miflag peligi behu, ikka leman deamar: kadshi likrav, veikka leman deamar: kadshi liriyyay.
Dilachar pidyonan, ma tehe alehen? amar rav huna: konsan lakkippa, vehen metin. dehechi lebed? likrevinhu — mikkoach kedushsha dechuya kaatu, lifrekinhu — la allimi lemitpas pidyonan.

Amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi chanina: samuch lefidyonan matpisan leshem oto zevach. samuch lefidyonan? lememra divne pediyyay ninhu? ella ema: samuch lefidyon imman matpisan leshem oto zevach. tama may? amar rabbi levi: gezera shemma yegaddel mehen adarim adarim.

Bea minneh ravina merav sheshet: mahu shemmatpisan lechol zevach sheyyirtze? amar leh: en matpisan. may tama? amar leh: gamar "bisharecha" "bisharecha" mibbechor, ma bechor en matpisan lechol zevach sheyyirtze, dichtiv: "ach bechor asher yevukkar laAdonai bivhema vegomer lo yakdish ish oto", af hane en matpisan lechol zevach sheyyirtze.

Tanya kevavteh derav sheshet: kodashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu — chayyayvin babbechora uvammattanot, ben lifne pidyonan ben leachar pidyonan — haggozez vehaoved bahen eno sofeg et haarbaim, ben lifne pidyonan ben leachar pidyonan — en osin temura.

Velifne pidyonan — moalin bahen, uleachar pidyonan — en moalin bahen, uvaldotehen — chol, venifdin temimim, umatpisan lechol zevach sheyyirtze. kelalo shel davar: hare hen kechullin lechol divrehem, en lecha bahem ella mitzvat illuy bilvad.

Aval kadam hekdeshan et muman, o mum over lehekdeshan, uleachar mikkan nolad mum kavua venifdu — peturin min habbechora umin hammattanot, ben lifne pidyonan ben leachar pidyonan. haggozez vehaoved bahen sofeg et haarbaim, uven lifne pidyonan ben leachar pidyonan — osin temura.

Lifne pidyonan — moalin bahen, uleachar pidyonan — en moalin bahen, uvaldotehen kodesh, veen nifdin temimin, veen matpisan lechol zevach sheyyirtze. kelalo shel davar: hare hen kehekdesh lechol divrehem, veen lach bahen ella hetter achila bilvad.
"Kelalo shel davar" deresha — leetoye shochatan bechutz defatur, "kelalo shel davar" desefa —

a: Leetoye chalavo.
Amar mar: en nifdin temimin, veen matpisan lechol zevach sheyyirtze. temimim hu dela mipparki, ha baale mumin — mipparki. lechol sheyyirtze hu deen matpisan, ha leoto zevach — matpisan.
Hechi mashkachat la? dematpisan leoto zevach, venifdin bemuman. nema tehve teyuveta derav huna?

Amar lecha rav huna: hu haddin daafillu baale mumin en nifdin, veayyeyde ditna resha "nifdin temimim" — tena name sefa "en nifdin temimim", veayyeyde ditna resha "lechol zevach sheyyirtze" — tena name sefa "lechol zevach sheyyirtze".
Vehashshochatan bachutz patur. rav huna matne chayyayv, umokem la bedukin shebbeayin, veallibba derabbi akiva deamar: im alu lo yerdu.

Ben lifne pidyono ben leachar pidyono ose temura. amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: utemurato leachar pidyono meta. may tama? hechi lebed? laykrevay — mikkoach kedushsha dechuya kaatya, lifreka — la allima lemitpas pidyonah, hilkach meta.

Matkef la rav amram: vetittechil bemumah labbealim! vechi ma ben zo litmurat bechor umaaser? ditnan: temurat bechor umaaser, hen uveladan uvelad veladan ad sof kol haolam — hare hen kivchor umaaser, veyeachlu bemuman labbealim!
Amar leh abbaye: ze shem immo alav veze shem immo alav, ze kullo temurat bechor umaaser mikkarya, ma bechor umaaser bemuman mitachlan labbealim, af temuratan mitachla.
Veze shem immo alav, temurat kadashim mikkarya, ma kadashim la mittachli ella befidyon — af temuratan name la mittachli ella befidyon, veha la allima lemitpas pidyona.
Tanya kevavteh derav nachman: minnayin litmurat pesule hammukedashin shemmeta? talmud lomar: "mimmaale haggera... tame", hay mibbee leh lechamesh chattaot metot! hahu mimmafrise happarsa tame" nafka.
Tanya name hachi: minnayin lechamesh chattaot metot? talmud lomar: "mimmafrise happarsa... tame". chamesh chattaot metot, hilcheta gemiri la, ella ki ata kera litmurat asham.
Temurat asham name hilcheta hi, kol shebbachattat meta — baasham roe!

Ella, leolam chamesh chattaot metot, veitzterich kera veitzterich hilcheta, dei mikkera hava amena liriyyay, ka mashma lan hilcheta lemita. vei mehilcheta hava amena: hecha daavad ikkeri vaachal mehane chamesh chattaot — issura ikka, lav lekka, kamashma lan deikka lav.
Veibbaet ema: leakkoshe davar habba mimmaale gera ledavar habba "mimmafrise happarsa", ma lehallan bemita — af kan bemita.
Mishna hamekabbel tzon barzel min haggoy —
b: Valdotehen peturin, valde valdotehen chayyayvin. heemid valdotehen tachat immotehen — valde veladot peturin, uvalde vavlde vevladot chayyayvim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: afillu ad asara peturim, sheachrayutan lannochri.
Rachel sheyyalda min ez, veez sheyyalda min rachel — petura min habbechora, veim yesh bo miktzat simanin — chayyayv.
Gemara lememra, dechevan dela naket mara zuze — birshuta demara kayyma?
Ureminhu: en mekabbelin tzon barzel miyyisrael mippene shehu ribbit, alma birshuta dimkabbel kayyma!
Amar abbaye: la kashya, ha dekabbel aleh unesa vezola, veha dela kabbel aleh unesa vezola.
Amar leh rava: dekabbel aleh unesa vezola, "tzon barzel" karet leh? veod, may paska?
Veod, addetane sefa aval mekabbelin tzon barzel min haggoy — liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim? dela kabbel aleh unesa vezola, aval kabbel aleh unesa vezola — shappir dame!

Ella amar rava: idde veidde dela kabbel aleh unesa vezola, vehacha gabbe bechora hayeynu tama, deillu ate goy bae zuze vela yahev leh — tafes la livhema, vei la mashkach la livhema — tafes veladot dida, vahare yad goy baemtza, vechol yad goy baemtza — petura min habbechora.

Heemid valdotehen tachat immotehen — valde veladot peturim. amar rav huna: veladot peturin, vavlde (valdotehen) [veladot] chayyayvin. verav yehuda amar: valde veladot name peturin, vavlde valde veladot chayyayvin.
Tenan: heemid veladot tachat immotehen — valde veladot peturin. tama deheemid, ha lo heemid — la. teyuveta derav yehuda!
Amar lach rav yehuda: hu haddin, af al gav delo heemid, veha ka mashma lan: afillu heemid name.
Deorcheh degoy lemitpas benah, vehave kemi delo heemid — valde veladot peturin, vavlde valde veladot chayyayvin.
Tenan: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: afillu ad asara dorot peturin, sheachrayutan lannochri. bishlama lerav yehuda deamar: nachet tanna kamma ledare —

a: Hayeynu daamar leh rabban shimon ben gamliel: afillu ad asara dorot peturin. ella lerav huna deamar: la nachet tanna kamma ledare, may "afillu ad asara dorot"? amar lecha rav huna: rabban shimon ben gamliel aheemid" kae denachet ledare.
Ta shema: hamekabbel tzon barzel min haggoy — veladot peturin, vavlde veladot lo. teyuveta derav yehuda! amar lach rav yehuda, ema: hen uvaldotehen.
Ikka deamri: hen uvaldotehen peturin, teyuveta derav huna! amar lecha rav huna: ema hen vevladot — patur, vavlde veladot — chayyayv.
Rachel sheyyalda min ez kulei. ata rav oshaya minnehardea, veayyti matnita bideh: rachel bat ez, veez bat rachel — rabbi meir mechayyev, vachachamim potrin.
Amar leh rav hoshaya lerabba: ki ayylat lekammeh derav huna, bei minneh: rabbi meir mechayyev lemay? ilema livchora — velet leh lerabbi meir "ach bechor shor" ad sheyyehe hu shor uvechoro shor?
Ella lereshit haggez, velet leh ha detana deve rabbi yishmael: kevasim shetztzamran kashe peturin mereshit haggez, shenneemar: "umiggez kevasay yitchammam"?

Amar leh: nichze anan, hacha bemay askinan? berachel sheyyalda min ez, veaviv tayish, uvechoshshin lezera haav leinyan oto veet beno kamippalgi, derabbi meir savar: choshshin lezera haav, verabbanan savri: en choshshin lezera haav.
I hachi, lippalgu bechoshshin lezera haav bealma, biflugeta dachananya verabbanan!
Ella, leolam livchora, vehacha bemay askinan — berachel bat rachel bat ez. mar savar: zil batar immeh, vehay lav nidme hu.
Umar savar: zil batar immay deimmeh, vehay nidme hu.
Veibbaet ema, berachel bat ez bat rachel, mar savar: chazru seyuyot limkoman, umar savar: lo chazru seyuyot limkoman.
Rav ashe amar: kegon sheyyesh bo miktzat simanin, uman chachamim? rabbi shimon, deamar: ad sheyyehe rosho verubbo dome leimmo.
Amar rabbi yochanan: mode rabbi meir besair shel rosh chodesh devaenan ben seira, may tama? amar kera: "echad" hameyuchad uva mishsheshet yeme bereshit.
Veha mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka — "shor o chesev" — perat lechilayim, "o ez" — perat lenidme.
Tzericha, dei mehatam hava amena: hane mille hecha dela nechat ledare, aval hecha dinchat — ema la. vei mehacha hava amena: hane mille legabbe korban chova, aval nedava — la, tzericha.
Amar rabbi acha bar yaakov: hakkol modim deen lokin al tzamro mishshum kilayim, shenneemar: "lo tilbash shaatnez", ma pishtan shello nishtanna — af tzemer shello nishtanna.
Amar rav pappa: hakkol modim shetztzamro pasul litchelet, shenneemar: "lo tilbash shaatnez... gedilim taase lach", ma pishtan shello nishtanna — af tzemer shello nishtanna.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: hakkol modim sheen tzamro mittamme bingaim, shenneemar: "beveged tzemer o beveged pishtim", ma pishtim shello nishtanna — af tzemer shello nishtanna.
Amar rav ashe: af anu nomar, hidla haggefen al gabbe teena — yeno pasul linsachim. may tama? "zevach unesachim" — ma zevach shello nishtanna, af nesachim shello nishtannu.

Matkef la ravina: hidla pishtan al gabbe higa — hachi name delishtanne? im ken la matzet amrat "ma pishtan shello nishtanna", deha pishtan name mishtanne! amar leh: ze nishtanna recho, veze lo nishtanna recho.

Mishna rachel shello bikkera veyalda shene zecharim, veyatzu shene rashehen keachat — rabbi yose haggelili omer: shenehen lakkohen, shenneemar: "hazzecharim laAdonai", vachachamim omrim: i efshar letzamtzem, ella echad lo veechad lakkohen.
Rabbi tarfon omer: hakkohen borer lo et hayyafe. rabbi akiva omer: meshammenin benehen, vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev.
b: Vechayyayv bammattanot, verabbi yose poter. met echad mehen — rabbi tarfon omer: yachloku, rabbi akiva omer: hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. zachar unekeva — en kan lakkohen kelum.
Gemara amri deve rabbi yannay: lerabbi yose haggelili shaminan leh deamar efshar letzamtzem bide shamayim, vechol shekken bide adam, verabbanan — bide shamayim i efshar letzamtzem, bide adam may?

Ta shema: chut shel sikra chogro baemtza, lehavedil ben damim haelyonim uven damim hattachtonim. vei amrat i efshar letzamtzem bide adam, zimnin deka yahev elyonim lematta vetachtonim lemala! demarvavch bah pureta.
Ta shema mimmiddat kelim, mimmiddat mizbeach. shane hatam, derachamana amar aved, uvechol hechi dematzet lemibad nicha leh, "hakkol bichtav miyyad Adonai alay hiskil".
Amar rav kattina, ta shema: chilleko lishnayim vehen shavin — shenehen temeim, lefi shei efshar letzamtzem. amar rav kahana: shane keli cheres hoil veyesh bo gummot.
Ta shema: nimtza mechvvavn ben shete ayayrot, shetehen meviot shete agalot, divre rabbi eliezer. may tama?
Lav mishshum dekasavar bide adam efshar letzamtzem, ukerova — vaafillu kerovot?
La, rabbi eliezer

a: Savar la kerabbi yose haggelili, deamar: efshar letzamtzem bide shamayim, vechol shekken bide adam.

Nema ketannae: nimtza mechvvavn ben shete ayayrot — lo hayu orfin, rabbi eliezer omer: shetehen meviot shete agalot. may lav beha kamippalgi, detanna kamma savar: i efshar letzamtzem, verabbi eliezer savar: efshar letzamtzem?
Vetisbera? i kasavar tanna kamma i efshar letzamtzem, ammay lo hayu orfim? yaviu egla achat beshuttafut, veyittenu!
Ella, lehane tannae dechulle alma efshar letzamtzem, vehacha bikrova" velo kerovot kamippalgi, detanna kamma savar: "kerova" velo kerovot, verabbi eliezer savar: "kerova" vaafillu kerovot.

May have ala? amar rav chiyyay bar avin amar rav amram: tana nimtza mechvvavn ben shete ayayrot, rabbi eliezer omer: shetehen meviot shete agalot, vachachamim omrim: yaviu egla achat beshuttafut veyatnu.

May kasavri rabbanan? i kasavri rabbanan deefshar letzamtzem, ukerova — vaafillu kerovot, layyte tarte! vei "kerova" velo kerovot, afillu chada la layyte! ella lav shema minna kasavri rabbanan: i efshar letzamtzem, vaafillu bide adam. shema minna.
Rabbi tarfon omer: borer lo et hayyafe. may tama derabbi tarfon? ka savar: hahu devari nafek beresha.

Rabbi akiva omer: "meshammenin" kulei. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hakkohen notel kechusha. amar leh rabbi chiyyay bar abba lerabbi yochanan: veha anan "meshammenin benehen" tenan! amar leh: ad daachalt kafneyayta bevavel, targemna missefa.

Dekatane sefa: met echad mehen, rabbi tarfon omer: yachloku, rabbi akiva omer: hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. vei salka datach "meshammenin benehen" dechi hadade peligi, hachi name (lippalgi) [liflog] gabbe hadade! ella may "meshammenin" — shomen yehe benehen, deamar leh lechohen: ayyti reaya divchor hu ushekoyl.

Vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev, vechayyayv bemattanot, verabbi yose poter. may tama derabbi meir? amar rabbi yochanan: hoil vechohen ba alav mishshene tzedadin, deamar leh: i bechor hu — kulleh didi hu, i la bechor hu — hav li mattanot minneh.
Verabbi yose may tama? amar rava: asu sheeno zoche kezoche, veaf al gav dela meta lideh keman dimta lideh, vezabbeneh leyisrael bemumeh.
Amar rabbi elazar: hakkol modim bisfek bechor, sheen chalifin beyad kohen, shechayyayv bemattanot.
Hakkol modim man? rabbi yose? peshita! ad kan la ka fatar rabbi yose hatam, ella dachalifin beyad kohen, deasu sheeno zoche kezoche, aval en chalifin beyad kohen — la!
Mahu detema: tama derabbi yose, dekasavar dei mechayyeyvat leh bemattanot — ate leh lide gizza vaavoda, af al gav deen chalifin beyad kohen, ka mashma lan.
Umi matzet amrat hachi? vehatane sefa, shehaya rabbi yose omer:
b: Kol shechalifav beyad kohen patur min hammattanot, verabbi meir mechayyev. chalifin beyad kohen — in, en chalifin beyad kohen — la!

Mahu detema: rabbi yose lidvarav derabbi meir kaamar leh — ledidi, afillu en chalifin beyad kohen, dei mechayyeyvat leh bemattanot ate leh lide gizza vaavoda; ledidach, odi li miha hecha dachalifin beyad kohen, deasu sheeno zoche kezoche; veamar leh rabbi meir: la.

Veamar rav pappa: hakkol modim bisfek maaser sheppatur min hammattanot. "hakkol modim" — man? rabbi meir? peshita! ad kan la kamchayyev rabbi meir hatam ella bisfek bechor, hoil uva alav kohen mishshene tzedadin, aval safek maaser — la.
Mahu detema: tama derabbi meir delo tishtakkach torat mattanot, afillu sefek maaser name? ka mashma lan.
Umi matzet amrat hachi? vehakatane sefa, shehaya rabbi yose omer: kol shechalifav beyad kohen — patur min hammattanot, verabbi meir mechayyev!
Mahu detema: rabbi meir afillu sefek maaser mechayyayv, veha demippalgi bachalifin — lehodiacha kocho derabbi yose, defatar afillu hecha dechohen ba alav mishshene tzedadin, ka mashma lan.

Met echad mehen, rabbi tarfon omer: yachloku. ammay yachloku? nichze: i shamen mit — dechohen hu, vehay deikka devaal habbayit; vei kachush mit — devaal habbayit mit, vehay deikka dechohen hu! amar rabbi amme: chazar bo rabbi tarfon.
Rabbi akiva omer: hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. amar rabbi chiyyay: mashal derabbi tarfon lema haddavar dome? lishnayim shehifkidu etzel roe, shemmanniach roe benehem umistallek.
Umashal derabbi akiva: lema haddavar dome? leechad shehifkid etzel baal habbayit, shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya.

Ella bemay peligi? rabbi akiva pelig bishnayim shehifkidu etzel roe, shemmanniach roe umistallek? verabbi tarfon pelig beechad shehifkid etzel baal habbayit? amar rava, veittema rav pappa: hakkol modim bishnayim shehifkidu etzel roe — shemmanniach roe benehem umistallek, uveechad shehifkid etzel baal habbayit — shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya.

Lo nechleku ella bachatzar baal habbayit, veroe kohen. rabbi tarfon savar: aknoye ka makne leh bachatzero, venicha leh delitavid mitzva bemamoneh, vehave leh kishnayim shehifkidu etzel roe, shemmanniach roe benehen umistallek.
Verabbi akiva savar: kevan deit leh peseda — la makne leh middaam, vehave leh keechad shehifkid etzel baal habbayit, shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya.

Mishna shete rechelav shello bikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim — shenehem lakkohen. zachar unekeva — hazzachar lakkohen. shene zecharim unekeva — echad lo veechad lakkohen. rabbi tarfon omer: hakkohen borer lo et hayyafe. rabbi akiva omer: meshammenin benehen, vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev.

Vechayyayv bammattanot, rabbi yose poter. met echad mehen, rabbi tarfon omer: yachloku, rabbi akiva omer: hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. shete nekevot vezachar o shene zecharim ushete nekevot — en kan lakkohen kelum.

Achat bikkera, veachat lo bikkera, veyalda shene zecharim, echad lo veechad lakkohen. rabbi tarfon omer: hakkohen borer et hayyafe. rabbi akiva omer: meshammenin benehen, vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev.

Vechayyayv bammattanot. rabbi yose poter, sherabbi yose omer: kol shechalifav beyad kohen patur min hammattanot. verabbi meir mechayyev. met echad mehen, rabbi tarfon omer: yachloku. rabbi akiva omer: hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. zachar unekeva — en kan lakkohen kelum.
Gemara tzericha, dei ashmoinan kammayyta, behahi kaamar rabbi akiva, ditre mechada.
Aval rechelav shello bikkeru, ditre mechada vechad mechada — ema mode leh lerabbi tarfon, dehach dilida chad sheviach tefe.
Vei ashmoinan ha — beha kaamar rabbi akiva, detarvayyhu lo bikkeru, aval achat bikkera veachat shello bikkera veyaldu shene zecharim — ema mode leh lerabbi tarfon,

a: Dehach dela bikkera sheviach tefe tzericha.

Mishna yotze dofen vehabba acharav, rabbi tarfon omer: shenehem yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyeachlu bemuman labbealim. rabbi akiva omer: shenehen enan bechor, harishon — mippene sheeno "peter rechem", vehashsheni — mippene shekkedamo acher.
Gemara bemay kamippalgi? rabbi tarfon mesappeka leh: bechor ledavar echad, i have bechor i la have bechor, verabbi akiva peshita leh: bechor ledavar echad la have bechor.
Tanu rabbanan: mikkelal hatztzarich lifrat umipperat hatztzarich lichlal, ketzad? "kaddesh li chol bechor", yachol afillu nekeva bammashma? talmud lomar "zachar".
I "zachar", yachol afillu yatzta nekeva lefanav? talmud lomar: "peter rechem". i "peter rechem", yachol afillu yatza achar yotze dofen? talmud lomar: "bechor".
Amar leh rav sherevya leabbaye: resha la kanasev la talmuda "bechor", alma bechor ledavar echad have bechor. sefa kanasev la talmuda "bechor", alma bechor ledavar echad la have bechor!
Amar leh: leolam bechor ledavar echad la have bechor, veresha hachi kaamar: i zachar, yachol afillu yotze dofen? talmud lomar "peter rechem".
Ravina amar: leolam bechor ledavar echad have bechor, vesefa hachi kaamar: i salka datach yatza acher yotze dofen kadosh, "bechor" dichtav rachamana lema li?
b: I lemaote hecha deyatzta nekeva lefanav — mippeter rechem" nafka! ella shema minna "bechor" lemaote hecha deyotze achar yotze dofen.

Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: i salka datach bechor ledavar echad have bechor, tinach hecha deyatza zachar yotze dofen vezachar derech rechem, dela kadosh, deimmaut leda mibbechor", divchor lirchamim ikka, bechor lizcharim lekka.
Ella hecha deyatzta nekeva derech dofen vezachar derech rechem — likdash, deha ikka bechor lizcharim uvechor lerechem! ella mechavvavrta kidabbaye.
Hadaran alach hallokeach ubbar parato.

Mishna hallokeach behema min haggoy, veeno yodea im bikkera im lo bikkera. rabbi yishmael omer: ez bat shenatah — vadday lakkohen, mikkan veelach — safek. rachel bat shetayim — vadday lakkohen, mikkan veelach — safek. para vachamor benot shalosh — vadday lakkohen, mikkan veelach — safek.
Amar lo rabbi akiva: illu bevavlad bilvad habbehema nifteret kidvarecha, ella amru: siman havvavlad bivhema dakka — tinnuf, uvaggassa — shilya, uvaishsha — shafir veshilya.
Ze hakkelal: kol sheyyadua shebbikkera — en kan lakkohen kelum, vechol shello bikkera — hare ze lakkohen, veim safek — yeachel bemumo labbealim.

Gemara mikkan veelach, ammay safek? hallech achar rov behemot, verov behemot mitabberot veyoldot betoch shenatan ninhu, veha vadday melad oled! lema rabbi yishmael kerabbi meir sevira leh, dechayesh lemiuta?
Afillu tema rabbanan, ki azli batar rubba berubba deiteh kamman, kegon tesha chanuyot vesanhedrin, aval rubba deleteh kamman — la azli rabbanan batar rubba.

Veha katan uketanna, derubba deleteh kamman, vekaazli rabbanan batar rubba, ditnan: katan uketanna lo choltzin velo meyaybmin, divre rabbi meir. amru lo: yafe amarta sheen choltzin, "ish" katuv bapparasha, umakkeshinan ishsha leish.
Ma taam en meyaybmin? amar lahem: katan — shemma yimmatze saris, ketanna — shemma timmatze ayylonit, venimtzeu pogin beerva.
Verabbanan, zil batar rubba ketannim, verov ketannim lav sarisim ninhu; zil batar ketannot, verov ketannot lav ayylonit ninhu!
Ella amar rava:

a: Mechavvavrta rabbi yishmael kerabbi meir sevira leh, dechayesh lemiuta.
Ravina amar: afillu tema rabbanan, ki azli rabbanan batar rubba — berubba dela tele bemaase, aval rubba ditle bemaase — la.

Tanu rabbanan: ez bat shenatah — vadday lakkohen, mikkan ulehallan — safek. rachel bat shetayim — vadday lakkohen, mikkan ulehallan — safek. para bat shalosh — vadday lakkohen, mikkan ulehallan — safek. chamora — kefara. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: chamora bat arba shanim. ad kan divre rabbi yishmael.

Keshennemeru devarim lifne rabbi yehoshua, amar lahen: tzeu imru lo lerabbi yishmael: taita! illu bevavlad bilvad habbehema nifteret — haya kidvarecha, ella siman havvavlad bivhema dakka — tinnuf, uvaggassa — shilya, uvaishsha — shafir veshilya.

Vaani en ani omer ken, ella: ez shettinnefa bat shishsha — yoledet betoch shenatah, rachel shettinnefa bat shenatah — yoledet betoch shetayim. amar rabbi akiva: ani lo bati lide midda zo, ella: kol sheyyadua shebbikkera — en kan lakkohen kelum, vechol shello bikkera — hare zo lakkohen, safek — yeachel bemumo labbealim.
Bemay kamippalgi rabbi yishmael verabbi yehoshua? lema betinnuf poter kamippalgi, rabbi yishmael savar tinnuf eno poter, verabbi yehoshua savar tinnuf poter?
I dachazena detaynnivf — dechulle alma la peligi detinnuf poter, vehacha bechoshshin letinnuf ka mippalgi: rabbi yishmael savar: en choshshin letinnuf, verabbi yehoshua savar: choshshin letinnuf.
Vela chayesh? vehaamar rava: mechavvavrta rabbi yishmael kerabbi meir sevira leh, dechayesh lemiut! ki chayesh — lechumera, lekulla — la chayesh.

Veibbaet ema: ben lekulla ben lechumera chayesh, vehacha bimtannefet vechozeret veyoledet betoch shenatah kamippalgi, derabbi yishmael savar: metannefet enah chozeret veyoledet betoch shenatah, veha middeolid — vadday la tannif. verabbi yehoshua savar: metannefet chozeret veyoledet betoch shenatah.
Vaani eni omer ken, ella ez shettinnefa bat shishsha — yoledet toch shenatah, rachel shettinnefa bat shenatah — yoledet betoch shetayim. may ikka ben gemareh lisvareh?
Shettinnefa besof shishsha, veikka benayyhu dizeri, deamar zeeri: en tinnuf pachot mishsheloshim yom.
Ligmareh — it leh dizeri, lisvareh — let leh dizeri.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma it lehu dizeri, vehacha — beyoledet limkuttain kamippalgi;
b: Ligmareh — la amrinan yoledet limkuttain, lisvareh — amrinan yoledet limkuttain.
Veibbaet ema: la amrinan yoledet, vehacha bemiktzat hayyom kechullo kamippalgi. lisvareh — amrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo, ligmareh — la amrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo.
Amar rabbi akiva: ani lo bati lide midda zo, ella kol sheyyadua kulei. may ikka ben rabbi akiva lerabbi yehoshua?

Amar rabbi chanina missura: chalav poter ikka benayyhu, rabbi akiva savar: chalav poter, hallech achar rov behemot, verov behemot en cholvot ella im ken yoldot, verabbi yehoshua savar: ha ikka miuta decholvot af al pi sheen yoldot.
Umi chayesh rabbi yehoshua lemiut? vehatnan: hayta lah chamot — enah chosheshet, yatza melea — chosheshet. rabbi yehoshua omer: enah chosheshet.

Veamrinan: may tama derabbi yehoshua? kasavar: rov meubbarot yoldot, umiut mappilot, vechol hayyoldot — mechetza zecharim umechetza nekevot. semoch miuta demappilot lemechetza dinkevot, vehavu lehu zecharim miuta, ulemiuta la chayyshinan!
Ella efoch, vehatanya: chalav poter, divre rabbi yehoshua. rabbi akiva omer: chalav eno poter.

Tanu rabbanan: gediyyay sheyyalda shalosh banot, vechol benoteha yaldu shalosh shalosh — kullan nichnasot laddir lehitasser. amar rabbi shimon: ani raiti sheissera betoch shenatah. lema li lemitne shalosh shalosh? toled chad minnayyhu telat, veinach tarte tarte!
Ayyeyde deikka chada dela saggi bela shalosh, tena kullehu deyaldu shalosh shalosh. ulema li lemitne shalosh kelal? leldu kullehu tarte, vetihdar ihi vetoled bahadayhi!

a: Lema kasavar: metannefet enah chozeret veyoledet betoch shenatah. im timtze lomar: metannefet chozeret veyoledet betoch shenatah — yoledet vadday enah chozeret veyoledet betoch shenatah.
Amar rabbi shimon: ani raiti gediyyay kulei. may ikka ben tanna kamma lerabbi shimon? ikka benayyhu dizeri.

Tanna kamma it leh dizeri, verabbi shimon let leh dizeri. veibbaet ema: dechulle alma it lehu dizeri, vehacha beyoledet limkuttain ka mippalgi. letanna kamma enah yoledet limkuttain, lerabbi shimon yoledet.

Veibbaet ema, dechulle alma enah yoledet limkuttain, vehacha bemiktzat hayyom kechullo kamippalgi: letanna kamma — la amrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo, lerabbi shimon — amrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma amrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo, vehacha bimchussar zeman nichnas laddir lehitasser kamippalgi,
b: Vehatanya: rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: mechussar zeman nichnas laddir lehitasser, vahare hen kivchor — ma bechor kadosh lifne zemanno vekarev leachar zemanno, af mechussar zeman kadosh lifne zemanno vekarev leachar zemanno.
Veaddeyalef mibbechor, nelayf mikkodashim? mistabbera mibbechor hava leh lemelaf, shekken: goel, mum, temurat, achila.
Adderabba, mikkodashim hava leh lemelaf, shekken zachar, kadosh, bemattanot, pashut. ella rabbi shimon "haavara" "haavara" gemir.
Hechi dame tinnuf? amar rava, kidamri raavata: detzalta atzar chevta. ushemuel amar: babue didma. vetzarich lehareoto lechacham. chacham mena yada? amar rav pappa: roe chacham.

Amar rav chisda: hare amru yetzirat havvavlad baishsha arbaim yom. bae rav chisda: bivhema bechamma? amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: lav hayeynu dizeri, deamar zeeri: en tinnuf pachot mishsheloshim yom? hahu lekabbel ittemar.
Matzinu lokeach miggoy, lokeach miyyisrael may? amar rav: bechor vadday, deim ita devikkera — ishtabboche hava mishtabbach leh.
Ushemuel amar: bechor safek, savar lishchita ka vae leh. verabbi yochanan amar: chullin vaddain, may tama? im ita delo bikkera, kevan deikka issura, odoe hava moda leh.
Tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan, deamar chullin: im lo hodio — holech veshochet veeno nimna. lema tehve teyuveta derav ushemuel? hatam bemocher talya milleta, hacha belokeach talya milleta.
Mishna rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: behema gassa sheshshafa chararat dam, hare zo tikkaver, ufetura min habbechora.
Gemara tane rabbi chiyyay: enah metammea lo bemagga velo bemassa. umeachar deenah metammea lo bemagga velo bemassa, ammay tikkaver?

a: Kede lefarsemah shenniftera min habbechora.
Lememra devalad mealleya hu, veammay en metamme lo bemagga velo bemassa? amar rabbi yochanan: mishshum bittul berov nagu bah.
Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh, deamar rabbi yochanan: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov verabbi shimon amru davar echad, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov — ha daamaran.
Rabbi shimon may hi? ditnan: hashshilya babbayit — habbayit tame. lo shehashshilya valad, ella sheen shilya belo valad. rabbi shimon omer: valad nimmok ad shello yatza.
Tenan hatam: en linfalim petichat hakkever, ad sheyyaagilu rosh kefikka. may kefikka? amar rav huna: kefikka shel tzemer. amar leh chiyyay bar rav lerav huna: rabbi, paresh shel sheti o shel erev?

Amar leh: tanya: pikka shel sheti, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: shel erev. rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok omer: mishsheyyerau tefifiyyot. may tefifiyyot? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok: kach hayu mefarshin birushalayim: kifreda shekkoraat lehattil memeha, veniret pikka mittoch pikka.

Amar rav huna: shamati shete pikot, achat shel sheti veachat shel erev, veen li lefaresh. ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: shalosh pikot shamati, achat shel sheti veachat shel erev veachat shel pikka gedola shel sakkain, veen li lefaresh. ki ata ravin persha mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: shel ishsha keshel sheti, shel behema keshel erev.

Pikka gedola shel sakkain, keditnan: gush habba mibbet happeras, meeretz haammim — shiuro kefikka gedola shel sakkain, shehu kechotam hammartzufin, veyeshno betzad haelyon shel megufat hechavit hallachmit.
Amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda nesia: hallokeach tzir meam haaretz — mashshiko bemayim, vetahor.

Mimma nafshach, i mayya rubba ninhu — kevan deaved lehu hashshaka tahari lehu, vei rubba tzir ninhu — tzir la bar kabbole tumea hu. may ikka — mishshum hanach miuta demayya, hanach batlu lehu berubba.

Amar rabbi yirmeya: lo shanu ella litbol bahen pitto, aval likdera — lo, matza min et mino veneor. yatev rav dimi vekaamar leha shemata. amar leh abbaye: vechi tumea shebbatla chazra veneora? amar leh: veat la tisbera? vehatnan: sea teruma temea shennafla
b: Lemea chullin tehorin, rabbi eliezer omer: terom veterakev, sheani omer: hi sea shennafla hi sea shealta.
Vachachamim omrim: taale, veteachel nikkudim, o kelayot, o tillosh beme ferot, o titchallek leissot, uvilvad shello yehe bemakom echad kevetza.
Vetane ala: otan chullin

a: Lerabbi eliezer ma tehe alehen? yochlu nikkudin, o kelayot, o yilloshu beme ferot, o titchallek leissot, uvilvad shello yehe kevetza bemakom echad. veamar ulla: ma taam? gezera shemma yavi kav chullin temeim mimmakom acher vekav veod mimmin ze, savar eyvattelinhu berubba, vechevan deikka hay mashshehu — matza min et mino veneor.
Amar leh: im tumea oreret tumea, tohora oreret tumea?
Etiveh: efer kasher shennitarev beefer mikle, holchin achar harov letamme, vei rubba efer mikle hu — la metamme. vei amrat: tumea keman deiteh dame, nehi divmagga la metamme — letamme bemassa!
Ha ittemar ala, amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: tahor milletamme bemagga, aval metamme bemassa.
Vehaamar rav chisda: nevela betela bishchuta, shei efshar linvela shettease shechuta. nehi divmagga la metamme, letamme bemassa!

Amar leh: attun bidrav chisda matnitu la, anan bidrabbi chiyyay matnenan la. tane rabbi chiyyay: nevela ushechuta betelot zo bazo, veittemar ala, amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: tahor milletamme bemagga, aval metamme bemassa.

Veha ditnan: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: behema gassa sheshshafa chararat dam — hare zo tikkaver, veniftera min habbechora. vetane rabbi chiyyay: enah metammea lo bemagga velo bemassa. ammay? dinhi bemagga la metamme, tetamme bemassa! ishtik.
Dilma, vadday shane hacha, dehavya la tumea serucha. hanicha levar peda, deamar: tumea chamura ad leger, vetumea kalla ad lechelev, ha la chazya leger. ella lerabbi yochanan deamar:
b: Achat zo veachat zo ad lechelev, ha chazya lechelev! kashya.

Gufa, bar peda amar: tumea chamura ad leger, vetumea kalla ad lechelev. verabbi yochanan amar: achat zo veachat zo ad lechelev. may tama devar peda? dichtiv: "lo tochlu chol nevela leger vegomer", haruya lagger keruya "nevela", vesheenah reuya lagger enah keruya "nevela".
Veiddach? lemaote hecha dehisricha meikkara. veiddach? hisricha meikkara la tzericha kera lemaote, afra bealma hu.

Tenan: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: behema gassa sheshshafa chararat dam, hare zo tikkaver, venifteret min habbechora. vetane rabbi chiyyay: enah metammea lo bemagga velo bemassa. veamar rabbi yochanan: mishshum bittul berov nagu bah.
May irya mishshum bittul berov? tippok li dela itchazi kelal! ha name itchazi meikkara aggav immeh.

Tenan hatam: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: tzir tahor shennafal letocho mayim kol shehu — tame. amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: zot omeret nechshedu amme haaretz learev mechetza batztzir. ulema li mechetza? afillu betzir mimmechetza name! vehane mashshehu — have leh palga, ufalga la betil.
Ema: ad mechetza. ibbaet ema: tumeat am haaretz derabbanan, tumeat mashkin derabbanan. berubba gezaru rabbanan, befalga ufalga la gezaru ba rabbanan.

Mishna rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hallokeach behema menika min haggoy — en choshshin shemma benah shel acheret haya. nichnas letoch edro veraa et hammavkirot menikot, vesheenan mavkirot menikot — en choshshin shemma benah shel zo ba lo etzel zo, o shemma benah shel zo ba lo etzel zo.

Gemara amar rav nachman mishshemeh derav: hilcheta bechulleh pirkin, bar mippelugeta. amar rav sheshet: amena ki nayem veshachev rav amar leha shemata! aheyay? illema aresha — (mapelaygay) [miflag peligi] rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva!
Ella adderabbi eliezer ben yaakov — mishnat rabbi eliezer ben yaakov "kav venaki".

Ella adderabban shimon ben gamliel miflag pelig bevarayyta! ella adderabbi yose ben hameshullam — ha amar rav chada zimna, deamar rav: hilcheta kerabbi yose ben hameshullam! ella assear baal mum miflag peligi akavya ben mahalalel verabbanan!
Leolam adderabban shimon ben gamliel, veha ka mashma lan: devarayyta la pelugeta hi.
Vechevan deamar rav: hilcheta bechulleh pirkin bar mippelugeta,

a: Halacha kerabbi yose ben hameshullam lema li?

I amar hilcheta dechulleh pirkin, vela amar hilcheta kerabbi yose ben hameshullam, hava amena: adderabbi yose ben hameshullam kae, umay "bechulleh pirkin"? derabbi yose tarte amar, ufelugeta devarayyta pelugeta hi.
Ashmeinan halacha kerabbi yose — leashmoinan deadderabban shimon ben gamliel kae, ufelugeta devarayyta lav pelugeta hi.
May barayyta? detanya: hallokeach behema menika min haggoy, habba acharav bechor missafek, mippene shemmerachemet af al pi sheenah yoledet. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: davar bechezkato.

Vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hannichnas letoch edro ballayla veraa keeser kachamesh esre, mavkirot vesheenan mavkirot, yoldot, lemachar hishkim umatza zecharim (teluyot) [teluyin] besheen mavkirot, unekevot teluyot bemavkirot — eno choshesh shemma benah shel zo ba lo etzel zo.
Ibbaya lehu: davar bechezkato dekaamar rabban shimon ben gamliel, deenah merachemet ella im ken yoledet — ha hecha deolid chayyshinan lerachome, o dilma: dida merachama, dela dida la merachama leh?
Lemay nafka minna? lemilke ala mishshum "oto veet beno". i amrat dida merachama, dela dida la merachama — lake, vei amrat dela dida name merachama — la lake.

May? ta shema, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hallokeach behema min haggoy — eno choshesh shemma benah shel acheret haya. mi katane "hu"? "haya" katane! hachi kaamar: eno choshesh shemma benah shel acheret, ella im ken haya lah valad meikkara.
Ta shema: nichnas betoch edro veraa et hammavkirot menikot, veet sheenan mavkirot menikot — eno choshesh shemma benah shel zo ba lo etzel zo, o shemma benah shel zo ba lo etzel zo.
Ammay? lechush dilma rachome rachem! bimkom dida, la shavka dida umerachama dela dida.
Ta shema: davar bechezkato kulei. may lav resha dumeya desefa? ma sefa vadday dida, af resha vadday dida.
Midde irya? hay kidite, vehay kidite. umay "vechen"? appetura divchora.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: raa chazir shekkaruch achar rachel, petura min habbechora, veasur baachila "ad yavo veyore tzedek lachem".
Patur min habbechora — keman? kerabban shimon ben gamliel, veasur baachila — kerabbanan.
Vetu, i kerabbanan, may "ad yavo veyore tzedek lachem"? "ad sheyyivvada lecha davar" mibbee leh!

Vechi tema: mesappeka leh i halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel i kerabbanan, i mesappeka leh — ammay petura min habbechora? vetu: mi mesappeka leh? vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol makom sheshshana rabban shimon ben gamliel bemishnatenu — halacha kemoto, chutz mearev, vetzaydan, ureaya acharona!

Leolam peshita leh halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, mihu mesappeka leh i savar rabban shimon ben gamliel yoledet merachemet, o enah merachemet. i hachi, ad deashmeinan chazir, layshmeinan tale, ulemilke aleh mishshum "oto veet beno"!

Chazir itztericha leh, dei ashmeinan tale, hava amena: im timtza lomar desavar yoledet merachama — demina, dela mina — la. ashmeinan chazir, dimrachemet, vaafillu delav mina name, deikka lememar dilma merachama.
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi yochanan: bae
b: Achay beribbi: raa chazir shekkaruch achar rachel, mahu? may kamibbaya leh? illema livchora, vekamibbaya leh i hilcheta kerabban shimon ben gamliel i hilcheta kerabbanan, tibbee leh tale!
Ki kamibbaya leh, livchora veallibba derabbanan, laachila veallibba derabban shimon ben gamliel.
Livchora, vaafillu lerabbanan deamri merachama, ki merachama demina, dela mina — la, o dilma dela mina name merachama?
Laachila, vaafillu lerabban shimon ben gamliel — im timtza lomar savar: yoledet merachama demina, delav mina — la; o dilma: delav mina name merachama? teku.
Mishna rabbi yose ben hameshullam omer: hashshochet et habbechor, ose makom bekofitz mikkan umikkan, vetolesh et hassear, uvilvad shello yezizennu mimmekomo, vechen tolesh et hassear lirot mekom mum.

Gemara amar rav: halacha kerabbi yose ben hameshullam. beo minneh merav huna: kenegdo beyom tov mahu? tama derabbi yose ben hameshullam mishshum dekasavar tolesh lav hayeynu gozez, uveyom tov asur, dehave leh oker davar miggiddulo.
O dilma bealma savar rabbi yose ben hameshullam tolesh hayeynu gozez, vehayeynu tama dishre, dehave leh davar sheen mitkavven, uveyom tov davar sheen mitkavven muttar?

Amar lehu: zilu shayylu lerav chananel, i amar halacha kerabbi yose ben hameshullam, efshot lechu. ato shayylu, amar lehu: hachi amar rav: halacha kerabbi yose ben hameshullam. ato lekammeh derav huna, amar lehu: kenegdo beyom tov muttar. ittemar name, amar rav chananya bar shelemya mishshemeh derav: kenegdo beyom tov

a: Muttar.
Umi amar rav hachi? veha amar rav chiyyay bar ashe mishshemeh derav: mesocharya denazyayta asur lehaddokay beyoma tava!
Behahi, afillu rabbi shimon mode, deabbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut.

Veha amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: halacha kerabbi yehuda, verav chanan bar amme amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi shimon, verav chiyyay bar avin matne bela gavre: rav amar halacha kerabbi yehuda, ushemuel amar halacha kerabbi shimon!
Ella, leolam savar rav: davar sheen mitkavven asur, vetolesh lav hayeynu gozez, uveyom tov hayeynu tama dishre — dehave leh oker davar miggiddulo kilachar yad.

Vetolesh lav hayeynu gozez? vehatanya: hattolesh et hakkanaf, vehakkotmo, vehammorto — chayyayv shalosh chattaot. veamar resh lakish: tolesh — chayyayv mishshum gozez, kotem — chayyayv mishshum mechattech, memaret — chayyayv mishshum memachek! shane kanaf, dehayynu orcheh.
Umidderav savar kerabbi yose ben hameshullam, rabbi yose ben hameshullam savar la kerav, vesavar rabbi yose ben hameshullam davar sheen mitkavven asur?
Vehatanya: shete searot — ikkaran maadim, veroshan mashchir, rabbi yose ben hameshullam omer: gozez bemisparayim, veeno choshesh.

Shane para, delav bat gizza hi. vehatanya: "lo taavod bivchor shorecha velo tagoz bechor tzonecha", veen li ella shor baavoda vetzon begizza, minnayin litten et haamur shel ze baze veet haamur shel ze baze? talmud lomar: "lo taavod... velo tagoz"!
Ella, shane para, dekodshe bedek habbayit hi. vehaamar rabbi elazar: kodshe bedek habbayit asurin begizza vaavoda! midderabbanan. vehaikka issura derabbanan! ella, shane para dela shechicha.

Velichalla velappeka lechullin, veliguzza vahadar laykdesha! dameha yekarin. velebad lah kedishmuel, deamar shemuel: hekdesh shave mane shechillelo al shave peruta mechullal! emor deamar shemuel shechillelo, lechitchilla mi amar?
Ibbaet ema: rav savar la kerabbi yose ben hameshullam, verabbi yose ben hameshullam la savar la kerav.
Vetolesh et hassear, uvilvad shello yezizennu mimmekomo. amar rav ashe amar resh lakish: lo shanu ella bayyad, aval bichli — asur. vehakatane: ose makom bekofitz mikkan umikkan! teni: "lekofitz".

Vechen tolesh et hassear lirot mum. ibbaya lehu: lechattechilla o diavad? amar rabbi yirmeya: ta shema, tzemer hamesubbach baozen — rabbi yose ben hameshullam omer: tolsho umare et mumo. shema minna lechattechilla, shema minna.

Amar rav mari: af anan name tenena, vechen hattolesh et hassear lirot mekom mum. may "vechen"? illema shello (yazizu et) [yezizennu mi]mekomo — hasheta uma shochet, dishchitato mochachat alav, lo yezizennu — lirot mekom mum mibbaya?
Ella lav attolesh? shema minna lechattechilla, shema minna.
Mishna sear bechor baal mum shennashar, vehinnicho bachallon, veachar kach shechato — akavya ben mahalalel mattir,
b: Vachachamim osrin, divre rabbi yehuda. amar lo rabbi yose: lo baze hittir akavya ben mahalalel, ella sear baal mum shennashar vehinnicho bachallon veachar kach met — baze akavya ben mahalalel mattir vachachamim osrin.
Tzemer hameduledal babbechor, et shennire im haggizza — muttar, veet sheeno nire im haggizza — asur.
Gemara mikkelal deasar, hasheta bemet — share, shechato mibbaya?
Ella, lo baze hittir akavya vachachamim osrin, shechato — divre hakkol shere, ki peligi bemet.
Amar rabbi assi amar resh lakish: machloket beshehittiro mumeche, demar savar: gazrinan dilma ate leshahoyeh, umar savar: la gazrinan, aval lo hittiro mumeche — divre hakkol asur.
Metiv rav sheshet: baale mumin osrin bechol shehu, verabbi yose omer: yevakker.
Vehavenan ba: may "yevakker"? illema devaal mum hu, velishkeleh — mikkelal detanna kamma amar lav?

Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: hacha begizzat bechor baal mum askinan, shennitarvu begizze chullin. uman tanna kamma? rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: nishchatu — asri rabbanan. verabbi yose letameh, deamar: nishchatu — sharu rabbanan.
Vekatane: "yevukkar", may "yevukkar"? lav i "mum kavua" i "mum over" hu, af al gav shello hittiro mumeche.
Amar rava: lo; yevukkar, i hittiro mumeche — in, vei la — la.

Ki selek ravin, amra lishmata kammeh derabbi yirmeya. amar: bavlae tafshae, mishshum deyatvi beara dachashocha amri shemata dimchashshechan! la shemia lehu ha deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: machloket beshebbadak velo matza.
Vekamippalgi biflugeta derabbi meir verabbanan, ditnan, shehaya rabbi meir omer: kol davar shehaya bechezkat tumea — leolam hu betumeato, ad shettivvavda hattumea.
Vachachamim omrim: chofer ad shemmaggia lesela o livtula.
Rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: machloket keshebbadak umatza, vekamippalgi biflugeta derabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel.

Detanya: sade sheavad bah kever, nichnas betochah — tame. nimtza betochah kever, nichnas letochah — tahor, sheani omer: hu kever sheavad hu kever shennimtza, divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: tibbadek kol hassade kullah.

Verabbi assi, may tama la amar kerabbi chiyyay bar abba? amar lach: bishlama gabbe tumea, emar ba orev unetalah, ba achbar unetalah, ella hacha — baal mum lehecha azel? veiddach? emar mum over hava veittassi.

Verabbi chiyyay bar abba may tama la amar kerabbi assi? amar lach: bishlama sade, dirka lemikbar ba, ki hechi dikvar bah hay — kevar inash acharina. ella kadashim, kevan divdiki lan vekayymi, dirkayyhu lemippal behu muma? veiddach — aggav dimnaggechi ahadade, shechiach behu muma.
Metivi: hattolesh tzemer mibbechor tam, af al pi shennolad bo mum ushechato — asur. tama detam,

a: Ha baal mum shere, af al pi shello hittiru mumeche! tanna: kol hecha delo hittiro mumeche — tam kare leh.

Lema ketannae: hattolesh tzemer mibbechor tam, af al pi shennolad bo mum ushechato — asur. bechor baal mum shettalash mimmennu, veachar kach met — akavya ben mahalalel mattir, vachachamim osrim. amar rabbi yehuda: lo baze hittir akavya ben mahalalel, ella bisar bechor baal mum shennashar vehinnicho bachallon, veachar kach shechato — baze akavya ben mahalalel mattir, vachachamim osrin.

Amar rabbi yose: mode abba chalafta beze shehu muttar, aval beyichud amru chachamim: yannichennu bachallon, shemma yesh tikva. shechato — divre hakkol muttar, met — akavya ben mahalalel mattir vachachamim osrim.
Rabbi yose — hayeynu tanna kamma! ella lav hittiro mumeche ikka benayyhu?
Detanna kamma savar: hittiro mumeche — in, vei la — la, vaata rabbi yose lememar: af al gav delo hittiro mumeche!

Amar rava: la, dechulle alma i hittiro mumeche — in, i lo hittiro — la, veshalosh machlokot baddavar, detanna kamma savar: peligi bemet, vehu haddin lishchato, vehay dekamippalgi bemet — lehodiacha kocho daakavya.
Verabbi yehuda savar: bemet — divre hakkol asur, ki peligi — bishchato, vaata rabbi yose lememar: bishchato — divre hakkol muttar, ki peligi — bemet.

Amar rav nachman: halacha kerabbi yehuda, hoil utenan bivchirata kevavteh, ditnan: sear bechor baal mum shennashar vehinnicho bachallon, veachar kach shechato — akavya ben mahalalel mattir, vachachamim osrin.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: matnitin name dayka, ditnan: tzemer hameduledal babbechor, et shennire im haggizza — muttar, veet sheeno nire — asur.
Manni? illema rabbi yose; uvemay? ilema bishchato — ben akavya ben rabbanan, idde veidde mishra share!
Veella bemet? vei rabbanan — idde veidde mesar asri, vei akavya — ippecha mibbaya leh: nire im haggizza — asur, demita kaasra leh; eno nire im haggizza — muttar, demeikkara telish!
Ella peshita rabbi yehuda, uvemay? ilema bemet — ben laakavya ben lerabbanan, idde veidde mesar asri!
Ella lav bishchato? vei akavya — idde veidde mishra share! ella lav rabbanan hi? ushema minna: bishchato peligi. shema minna.
Bae rabbi yannay: hattolesh tzemer meola temima, mahu? tolesh? mi ikka man deshare? ella, tzemer shennitlash meola temima, mahu?
Dechattat veasham la tibbee lach, dechevan dilchappara atu — la meshahu lehu. divchor umaaser name, dechevan delav lechappara atu — meshahu lehu. ki tibbee lach deola, may? kevan
b: Deikkar lav lechappara ate — meshahe la, o dilma, kevan deola name mechappera aase — la meshahe la?
Ta shema: hattolesh tzemer mibbechor tam, af al pi shennolad bo mum, shechato — asur. tama detolesh, ha nitlash — share, vechol shekken ola dela meshahe la!
Hu haddin afillu nitlash name asur, vehay dekatane "tolesh" lehodiacha kocho daakavya, divvaal mum afillu betolesh name share.
Vehaanan "nashar" tenan! tena "nashar" lehodiacha kochan derabbanan, tena "tolesh" lehodiacha kocho daakavya.
Tzemer hameduledal kulei. hechi dame "eno nire im haggizza"? amar rabbi elazar amar resh lakish: kol sheikkaro hafuch kelappe rosho. rav natan bar oshaya amar: kol sheeno mitmaech im haggizza.
Veresh lakish, may tama la amar kerav natan bar oshaya? amar rabbi ila: kasavar resh lakish, lefi shei efshar laggizza belo nimin hameduledalot.
Hadaran alach hallokeach behema.

Mishna ad kamma yisrael chayyayvin littappel bivchor? baddakka — sheloshim yom, uvaggassa — chamishshim yom. rabbi yose omer: baddakka — shelosha chodashim. amar lo hakkohen betoch hazzeman: "tenehu li" — hare ze lo yittenennu lo. veim baal mum hu, veamar lo: "tenehu li sheochlennu" — muttar. uvishat hammikdash, im haya tamim, amar lo: "ten [li] veakrivennu" — muttar.

Habbechor neechol shana beshana, ben tam ben baal mum, shenneemar: "lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu shana veshana". nolad lo mum betoch shenato — rashshay lekayyeymo kol shenem asar chodesh. leachar shenem asar chodesh — eno rashshay lekayyeymo ella sheloshim yom.
Gemara menahane mille? amar rav kahana: deamar kera "bechor banecha titten li", "ken taase letzonecha".
"Meleatcha vedimacha lo teacher", "ken taase leshorcha".
Efoch ana! mistabbera demakdam lemakdam, dimachar ledimachar. adderabba, dismich leh ledismich leh!
Ella amar rava: amar kera "taase", hosif lecha hakkatuv asiyyay acheret beshorcha.
Veema: shittin! lo mesarcha hakkatuv ella lachachamim.

Tanya name hachi: "bechor banecha titten li", "ken taase letzonecha" — yachol af leshorcha? talmud lomar: "taase" — hosif lecha hakkatuv asiyyay acheret beshorcha, lo mesarcha hakkatuv ella lachachamim.

Mikkan amru: ad kamma yisrael chayyayvin lehittappel bivchor? bivhema dakka — sheloshim yom, begassa — chamishshim yom. rabbi yose omer: baddakka — shelosha chodashim, mippene shettippulah merubba. tana: mippene sheshshinneha dakkot.
Im amar lo hakkohen betoch hazzeman "tenehu li", hare ze lo yitten lo. may tama? amar rav sheshet: mippene shennire kechohen hamesayyea bevet haggoranot.

Tanu rabbanan: hakkohanim vehaleviyyim vehaaniyyim hamesayyeyim bevet haroim, uvevet haggoranot, uvevet hammitbachayim — en notnin lahem teruma umaaser bischaran, veim osin ken chillelu, vaalehen hakkatuv omer: "shichattem berit hallevi", veomer: "veet kodshe vene yisrael lo techallelu velo tamutu".
May "veomer"? vechi tema: mita la — ta shema: "veet kodshe vene yisrael lo techallelu velo tamutu".
Uvikkeshu chachamim lekonsan, velihyot mafrishin alehen teruma mishshalem, umippene ma lo kenasum? dilma ate leafroshe min happetur al hachiyyuv.
Uvechullan yesh bahen

a: Tovat hanaa labbealim.
Ketzad? yisrael shehifrish teruma mikkiryo, umetzao yisrael acher, veamar lo: "he lecha sela ze, utenehu leven bitti kohen" — muttar. im haya kohen lechohen — asur.
Vetanna may tama la kaamar mattenot kehunna? amar lach: teruma, dikdushshat hagguf hi, dechevan dela mittachala — la ate lemite ba.
Hane, kevan dikdushshat damim ninhu, ate lemite behon, devar mittachal kedushetayyhu aarbea zuze, veate leminhag behon minhag dechullin.
Amar rava: terumat chutza laaretz — en bah mishshum kohen hamesayyea bevet haggeranot. rav chama yahev leh leshammaeh.
Amar shemuel: terumat chutza laaretz — betela berov. rabba mevattelah berov, veochel lah bime tumeato.
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua, ki mitreme leh chamra ditruma, hava rame tere natle dechullin vachada natla ditruma, veshakel chad. mikkan veelach, rame chada veshakel chada.
Veamar shemuel: terumat chutza laaretz, ochel veholech, veachar kach mafrish.
Veamar shemuel: en terumat chutza laaretz asura ella bemi shehattumea yotza alav miggufo, vehane mille baachila, aval bingia — let lan ba.

Amar ravina: hilkach, nidda kotza challa, veochel lah kohen katan, vei lekka kohen katan — shakla la beresh massa, veshadya betannura, vahadar mafresha challa achariti, ki hechi delo tishtakkach torat challa, veochel lah kohen gadol.

Rav nachman verav amram verame bar chama havo kaazli bearba, selek rav amram leippenoye, atay hahi itteta allat kammayyhu, amara lehu: teme met mahu sheyyitbol veochel terumat chutza laaretz? amar leh rav nachman lerame bar chama:
b: Vechi hazzaa yesh lanu? amar leh rame bar chama: la lechush leh lesava. addehachi ata rav amram, amar lehu: hachi amar rav: teme met tovel veochel bitrumat chutza laaretz.
Velet hilcheta kevavteh, deamar mar zutera mishshemeh derav sheshet: teme sheretz tovel veochel bitrumat chutza laaretz, velet hilcheta kevavteh.
Bechor neechol shana beshana kulei. middekaamar "nolad bo mum betoch shenato", lememra dilshana dideh manenan. mena hane mille?
Deamar rav yehuda amar rav, deamar kera: "lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu shana veshana", ezohi shana shennichneset bachavertah? heve omer: shana shel bechor.
Deve rav tana: "shana beshana" — yom echad beshana zo, veyom echad beshana zo, limmed al habbechor shenneechol lishne yamim velayla echad.
Deve rav, mena lehu? yalfi mikkodashim, vekadashim gufayyhu menalan? amar rav acha bar yaakov: amar kera "keves ben shenato" — shenato shello, velo shana shel minyan olam.

Verav, neechol lishne yamim velayla echad, mena leh? nafka leh meuvesaram yihye lach kachaze hattenufa ucheshok hayyamin" — hikkisho hakkatuv lechaze vashok shel shelamim: ma lehallan shene yamim velayla echad, af kan shene yamim velayla echad.

a: Veiddach, i mehatam ikka lememar chaze vashok shel toda.
Veiddach, amar kera: "lecha yihye" — hosif lecha hakkatuv havaya acheret bivchor.
Veiddach, ha mehatam ikka lememar: hay "yihye lach" — limmed al bechor baal mum shennotno lechohen, shello matzinu lo bechol hattora kullah.
Veiddach, amar "uvesaram" — echad tam veechad baal mum, veiddach — "uvesaram" dehane bechorot dechullehu yisrael kaamar.

Nolad lo mum betoch shenato, rashshay lekayyeymo kol shenem asar chodesh. ibbaya lehu: hechi kaamar? nolad lo betoch shenato, rashshay lekayyeymo kol shenem asar chodesh, uleachar shenato name sheloshim? o dilma: hecha denolad bo mum betoch shenato, rashshay lekayyeymo kol shenem asar chodesh vetu la, vehecha denolad lo achar shenato, eno rashshay lekayyeymo ella sheloshim?

Ta shema, detanya: bechor bizman hazze, ad shello nira lehareoto lechacham — rashshay lekayyeymo shetayim veshalosh shanim, umishshennira lehareoto lechacham, nolad lo mum betoch shenato — rashshay lekayyeymo kol shenem asar chodesh.
Achar shenato eno rashshay lekayyeymo afillu yom echad, vaafillu shaa achat. aval mippene hashavat aveda labbealim, amru: rashshay lekayyeymo sheloshim yom.
Vaadayin tibbee li: sheloshim yom achar shenato, o dilma kodem shenato?

Ta shema: nolad lo mum bachamishsha asar yom betoch shenato, mashlimin lo chamishsha asar yom achar shenato. shema minna, mesayyay lerabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: notnin lo sheloshim yom mishshaa shennolad bo mum.

Ikka deamri, amar rabbi elazar: minnayin livchor shennolad bo mum betoch shenato shennotnin lo sheloshim yom achar shenato? shenneemar: "lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu shana veshana", (ezo) [ellu] hen yamim hachashuvin shana — heve omer ellu sheloshim yom.
Metivi: nolad lo mum bachamishsha asar yom betoch shenato — mashlimin lo chamishsha asar yom achar shenato. hashelama — in, mehava — la! teyuveta derabbi elazar, teyuveta.

Mishna hashshochet et habbechor umare et mumo — rabbi yehuda mattir, rabbi meir omer: hoil venishchat shello al pi mumeche — asur. mi sheeno mumeche veroe et habbechor, venishchat al piv — hare ze yikkaver, vishallem mibbeto.

Gemara amar rabba bar bar chana: bedukkin shebbaayin — dechulle alma la peligi deasur, mippene shehen mishtannin. lo nechleku ella bemumin shebbagguf, derabbi meir savar: gazrinan mumin shebbagguf attu dukkin shebbaayin, verabbi yehuda savar: la gazrinan mumin shebbagguf attu dukkin shebbaayin.

Tanya name hachi: hashshochet et habbechor umare et mumav — rabbi yehuda omer: bedukkin shebbeayin asur, mippene shehen mishtannin, bemumin shebbagguf muttar, mippene sheen mishtannin. rabbi meir omer: echad ze veechad ze asur, mippene shehen mishtannin. mippene shehen mishtannin salka datach? mumin shebbagguf mi mishtannin?! ella mippene hammishtannin.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak:
b: Matnitin name dayka, rabbi meir omer: hoil venishchat shello al pi mumeche asur. shema minna kenasa ka kanes rabbi meir, shema minna.
Ibbaya lehu: mippene hammishtannin — dechullehu mishtanni, o dilma ikka demishtanne veikka dela mishtanne?
Lemay nafka minna? leachchoshe sahadi. i amrat: kullehu mishtanni — shakkare ninhu, vei amrat: ikka demishtanne veikka dela mishtanne — samchinan alayyhu. may?
Ta shema, deamar rabba bar bar chana: sach li rabbi yoshiyya demin usha, bo vearekka bedukkin shehen mishtannim. middekaamar leh "bo vearekka", mikkelal deikka demishtanne veikka dela mishtanne.
Mi sheeno mumeche, veraa et habbechor venishchat al piv, hare ze yikkaver, vishallem mibbeto. lema tenan setama kerabbi meir? dilma bedukkin shebbaayin, vedivre hakkol.
Tana: keshehu meshallem — meshallem revia laddakka, umechetza laggassa. may tama? amar rav pappa: ze hefsed merubbe, veze hefsed muat.
I hachi, lefum peseda lishallem! amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav acha bar ika: mishshum gezerat megaddele behema dakka nagu bah.
Mishna dan et haddin, zikka et hachayyayv vechiyyev et hazzakkay, timme et hattahor vetiher et hattame — ma sheasa asuy, vishallem mibbeto. veim haya mumeche levet din — patur milleshallem.
Gemara lema tenan setama kerabbi meir, dedaen dina digrame? amar rabbi ila amar rav: kegon shennasa venatan bayyad.

Bishlama chiyyev et hazzakkay — kegon shennasa venatan bayyad, ella zikka et hachayyayv hechi dame? i daamar leh "patur atta" — veha lo nasa venatan bayyad! amar ravina: kegon shehaya lo mashkon unetalo hemennu.
Timme et hattahor — deagga behu sheretz, tiher et hattame — sheervan im perotav.
Mishna umaase befara shennittela haem shellah, veheechilah rabbi tarfon lichlavim, uva maase lifne chachamim beyavne, vehittiruha.
Veamar todos harofe: en para vachazira yotza mealekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim, sheen chotchin haem shellah, bishvil shello teled.
Amar rabbi tarfon: halcha chamorcha tarfon! amar lo rabbi akiva: rabbi tarfon, atta mumeche levet din, vechol hammumeche levet din patur milleshallem.
Gemara vetippok leh, detaa bidvar mishna, vetaa bidvar mishna chozer!
Chada veod kaamar: chada — detaa bidvar mishna chozer, veod — i name beshikkul haddaat taita, mumeche levet din atta, vechol hammumeche levet din patur milleshallem.
Mishna hannotel sachar lihyot roe et habbechorot — en shochatin al piv, ella im ken haya mumeche.

a: Keila beyavne, shehittiru lo (beyavne) chachamim lihyot notel arba issarot livhema dakka, veshishsha legassa, ben tam uven baal mum.
Gemara may tama? hay nefish tircheh, vehay la nefish tircheh.
Ben tam uven baal mum. bishlama baal mum — mishshum deka share leh, ella tam ammay? deim ken, ate lemichshedeh, veamri: hay baal mum tam hu, vehay deka share leh — mishshum agra.
I hachi, tam name amri: baal mum hu, vehay dela kashare leh savar ki hechi delishkol agreh zimna achariti! chad zimna takkinu le rabbanan, tere zimne la takkinu le rabbanan.
Mishna hannotel secharo ladun — dinav betelim, lehaid — edotav betelin, lehazzot ulekaddesh — memav me meara, efro efer mikle.
Im haya kohen, metammeehu mitterumato — maachilo umashko vesacho, veim haya zaken — markivo al hachamor, venoten lo secharo kefoel.
Gemara menahane mille? amar rav yehuda amar rav, deamar kera: "ree limmadti etchem vegomer", ma ani bechinnam — af attem bechinnam.

Tanya name hachi: "kaasher tzivvani Adonai elohay" — ma ani bechinnam, af attem bechinnam. uminnayin sheim lo matza bechinnam sheyyelammed besachar? talmud lomar: "emet kene". uminnayin shello yomar: keshem shellemadtiha besachar kach alammedenna besachar? talmud lomar: "emet kene veal timkor".
Lehazzot ulekaddesh — memav me meara, efro efer mikle. ureminhu: hamekaddesh beme chattat beefer chattat — hare zo mekuddeshet, af al pi shehu yisrael!
Amar abbaye: la kashya — kan bischar havaa umilluy, kan bischar hazzaa vekiddush.
Dayka name, dekatane hacha "lehazzot ulekaddesh", vehatam katane "hamekaddesh beme chattat uveefer chattat", shema minna.
Im haya kohen metammeehu mitterumato kulei. ihu gufeh hechi azel?
Levet happeras derabbanan, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: menappeach adam bet happeras veholech.
b: Verav yehuda bar amme mishshemeh derav yehuda amar: bet happeras shenniddash tahor.
I name: bishar tumeot, dela mazhar alayyhu.
Im haya zaken — markivo al hachamor. tena: kefoel batel. amar abbaye: kefoel batel shel otah melacha.

Mishna hechashud al habbechorot, en lokchin mimmennu besar tzevaim, velo orot sheenan avudim. rabbi eliezer omer: lokchin mimmennu orot shel nekeva, veen lokchin mimmennu tzemer melubban vetzoi, aval lokchin mimmennu tevi uvegadim.
Gemara besar tzevaim. demichallaf bidegla.
Velo orot sheenan avudim. ha avudim zavninan. im ita divchor hava — la hava tarach beh, savar: i shamu beh rabbanan mafsedu leh minnay.
Rabbi eliezer omer: lokchin mimmennu orot shel nekeva. may tama? midda yedia.
Vetanna kamma, im ken, zachar name chayek lezachruteh veamar "achbarim achlu", veiddach — be achbarim midda yedia.
Veen lokchin mimmennu tzemer melubban vetzoi, hasheta tzemer melubban la zavninan, tzoi mibbaya? ella, chada katane: tzemer melubban mitztzoato.
Aval lokchin mimmennu tevi uvegadim. hasheta tevi zavninan, begadim mibbaya? may begadim? namte.
Mishna hechashud al hashsheviit — en lokchin mimmennu pishtan, vaafillu serak, aval lokchin mehem tevi vearig.
Gemara hasheta tevi zavninan, arig mibbaya? may "arig"? tikke.
Mishna hechashud lihyot mocher teruma leshum chullin — en lokchin mimmennu afillu mayim vamelach, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: kol sheyyesh bo zikkat teruma umaasrot en lokchin mimmennu.
Gemara leetoye may? leetoye kirve dagim, dimarvi behu shemen zayit.
Hahu tabbacha dahava chashud lezabbone

a: Tarba deatma bemar dechanta, kanseh rava lezabbone afillu amgoze. amar leh rav pappa lerava: keman? kerabbi yehuda? i kerabbi yehuda, afillu mayim vamelach name!
Leolam rabbi shimon, uveissura degufeh kansinan leh. setam dardeke geru beamgoze, veazel umeshabbesh livne tabbache, vegare lehu beamgoze, umayytu leh tarba deatma, umezabben leh bemar dechanta.

Mishna hechashud al hashsheviit — eno chashud al hammaasrot, hechashud al hammaasrot — eno chashud al hashsheviit. hechashud al ze veal ze — chashud al hatteharot, veyesh shehu chashud al hatteharot — veeno chashud lo al ze velo al ze. ze hakkelal: hechashud al davar — lo dano velo meido.
Gemara may tama? sheviit la baaya choma, maaser — kevan devae choma, chamir leh.
Hechashud al hammaaser. may tama? maaser it leh pidyon, sheviit — kevan deka mittasra leh velet leh pidyon — chamira leh.
Hechashud al ze veal ze. kevan dachashid addeorayyta, kol shekken adderabbanan.
Veyesh chashud al hatteharot. may tama? nehi adderabbanan chashid, addeorayyta la chashid. ureminhi: neeman al hatteharot — neeman al sheviit, ha chashid — chashid!
Amar rabbi ilay: matnitin kesherinuhu shennoheg betzina betoch beto.
