Rabbi yannay berabbi yishmael amar: kegon dahava chashid letarvayyhu, vaata kamme rabbanan vekabbel attarvayyhu, vahadar ichashad achad minnayyhu, deamrinan: miggo dachashid aha — chashid name aiddach.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: zo divre rabbi akiva setimtaa, aval chachamim omrim: chashud al hashsheviit — chashud al hammaaser.
Man chachamim? rabbi yehuda, divatreh derabbi yehuda sheviit chamira lehu, dehahu dahava kare leh lechavreh "dayyayra bar dayyayrta", amar leh: tete li dela achali perot sheviit kevavtach.

Ikka deamri, amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: zo divre rabbi akiva setimtaa, aval chachamim omrim: chashud al hammaaser chashud al hashsheviit. uman chachamim? rabbi meir hi, deamar: chashud ledavar echad have chashud lechol hattora kullah.
Rabbi yona verabbi yirmeya talmide rabbi zeera, veamri la rabbi yona verabbi zeera talmide rabbi yochanan, chad amar: aval chachamim omrim chashud al hashsheviit
b: Chashud al hammaaser, uman chachamim? rabbi yehuda, vechad amar: hechashud al hammaaser chashud al hashsheviit, uman chachamim? rabbi meir.
Detanya: am haaretz shekkibbel alav divre chaverut, venechshad ledavar echad — nechshad lechol hattora kullah, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: eno nechshad ella leoto davar bilvad.
Hagger shekkibbel alav divre tora, afillu nechshad ledavar echad — have chashud lechol hattora kullah, vahare hu keyisrael meshummad. nafka minna, dei kaddesh — kiddushav kiddushin.

Tanu rabbanan: habba lekabbel divre chaverut, chutz middavar echad — en mekabbelin oto. goy shebba lekabbel divre tora, chutz middavar echad — en mekabbelin oto. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: afillu dikduk echad middivre sofrim.

Vechen ben levi shebba lekabbel divre leviyya, vechohen shebba lekabbel divre chehunna, chutz middavar echad — en mekabbelin oto, shenneemar: "hammakriv et dam hashshelamim vegomer", haavoda hammesura livne aharon, kol kohen sheeno mode bah — en lo chelek bakkehunna.

Tanu rabbanan: habba lekabbel divre chaverut, im reinuhu shennoheg betzina betoch beto — mekabbelin oto, veachar kach melammedin oto. veim lav — melammedin oto, veachar kach mekabbelin oto. rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: ben kach uven kach mekabbelin oto, vehu lamed kedarko veholech.

Tanu rabbanan: mekabbelin lichnafayim, veachar kach mekabbelin litharot, veim amar: "eni mekabbel ella lichnafayim" — mekabbelin oto. kibbel latteharot velo kibbel lakkenafayim — af latteharot lo kibbel.
Tanu rabbanan: ad kamma mekabbelin oto? bet shammay omrim: lemashkin — sheloshim yom, lichsut — shenem asar chodesh. uvet hillel omrim: echad ze veechad ze — lishnem asar chodesh.
Im ken, have leh mikkulle bet shammay umechumere bet hillel, ella bet hillel omrim: echad ze veechad ze lishloshim.
(Siman: chaver, talmid, techelet, meches, chazar, gabbay, beatzmo).

Tanu rabbanan: habba lekabbel divre chaverut — tzarich lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim, uvanav uvene beto enan tzerichin lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af banav uvene veto tzerichin lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim, lefi sheeno dome chaver shekkibbel leven chaver shekkibbel.

Tanu rabbanan: habba lekabbel divre chaverut — tzarich lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim, vaafillu talmid chacham tzarich lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim. zaken veyoshev bishiva — eno tzarich lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim, shekkevar kibbel alav mishshaa sheyyashav. abba shaul omer: af talmid chacham eno tzarich lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim, velo od ella sheacherim mekabbelin lefanav.

Amar rabbi yochanan: bime beno shel rabbi chanina ben antignos nishnet mishna zo. rabbi yehuda verabbi yose istappak lehu milleta bitharot, shaddaru rabbanan legabbe beno shel rabbi chanina ben antignos, ezilu emaru leh: leayyen ba. ashkechu deka taen teharot, otev rabbanan middideh legabbayyhu, vekae ihu leayyone ba.
Ato amri leh lerabbi yehuda verabbi yose, amar lehu rabbi yehuda: aviv shel ze bizza talmide chachamim, af hu mevazze talmide chachamim!
Amar lo rabbi yose: kevod zaken yehe munnach bimkomo, ella miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash nahagu kohanim silsul beatzman, sheen mosrin et hatteharot lechol adam.
Tanu rabbanan: chaver shemmet — ishto uvanav uvene beto hare hen bechezkatan, ad sheyyechashedu. vechen chatzer shemmochrin bah techelet — hare hi bechezkatah, ad shettippasel.

Tanu rabbanan: eshet am haaretz shennisset lechaver, vechen bitto shel am haaretz shennisset lechaver, vechen avdo shel am haaretz shennimkar lechaver — kullan tzerichin lekabbel divre chaverut battechilla. aval eshet chaver shennisset leam haaretz, vechen bitto shel chaver shennisset leam haaretz, vechen avdo shel chaver shennimkar leam haaretz — en tzerichin lekabbel divre chaverut battechilla.

Rabbi meir omer: af hen tzerichin lekabbel alehen divre chaverut lechattechilla. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir: maase beishsha achat shennisset lechaver vehayta komaat lo tefillin al yado, nisset leam haaretz vehayta kosheret lo kishre moches al yado.

a: Tanu rabbanan: vechullan shechazru bahen en mekabbelin otan olamit, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: chazru bematmoniyyot — en mekabbelin otan, befarhesya — mekabbelin otan.
Ikka deamri: im asu divrehen bematmoniyyot — mekabbelin otan, befarhesya — en mekabbelin otan.

Rabbi shimon verabbi yehoshua ben korcha omrim: ben kach uven kach mekabbelin otan, mishshum shenneemar: "shuvu banim shovavim". amar rabbi yitzchak ish kefar akko amar rabbi yochanan: halacha keoto hazzug.
Tanu rabbanan, barishona hayu omrim: chaver venaasa gabbay — dochin oto mechaverato, perash — en mekabbelin oto. chazru lomar: perash — hare hu kechol adam.

Rav huna bar chiyyay itztericha leh shata, hava ayel gabbeh rabba verav yosef vearba mea zuge derabbanan. shema deatu, ketayr lehu arba mea tachtake. lesof shemau denaasa gabbay, shelachu leh: zil lachashivuteh, zil lekadmuteh. shelach lehu: hadari bi. rav yosef la azal, rabba azal.
Rav yosef amar: tenena, perash — en mekabbelin oto; rabba amar: tenena, chazru lomar: perash — hare hu kechol adam.
Tanu rabbanan: kol habbechorot adam roe, chutz mishshel atzmo, veroe et kodashav, veet maserotav, venishal al tohorotav.
Amar mar: kol habbechorot adam roe chutz mishshel atzmo. bemay askinan? ilema bechad — mi meheman? ella bitlata, umi chashidi? vehatnan: meana o shechaltza befanav — yissaenna, mippene shehu bet din!
Leolam bechad, vechidamar rav chisda amar rabbi yochanan: beyachid mumeche, hacha name beyachid mumeche.
Veroe et kodashav, dei bae mitteshil alayyhu.
Umaserotav, dei bae shade beh muma bechulleh edreh.
Venishal al tohorotav, deha chazu leh bime tumeato.
Hadaran alach ad kamma yisrael chayyayvin.
Mishna kol pesule hammukedashin, hanaatan lahekdesh, nimkarin baitliz, venishchatin baitliz, venishkalin belitra,
Chutz min habbechor vehammaaser, shehanayaytan labbealim. pesule hammukedashin — hanayaytan lahekdesh.
Veshoklin mana keneged mana babbechor.
b: Gemara kol pesule hammukedashin hanaatan lahekdesh. emat? illema leachar pidyono — hanaatan lahekdesh? hanaatan divalim hu!
Ella lifne pidyono. nishchatin? ha bae haamada vehaaracha!
Hanicha leman deamar, kodshe mizbeach lo hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, ella leman deamar hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, may ikka lememar?
Ella leolam leachar pidyon, umay hanaatan lahekdesh? addemeikkara.
Dechevan deshare lehu mar, nimkarin baitliz venishchatin baitliz venishkalin belitra, tafe ufarek meikkara.
Chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser shehanayaytan labbealim. bishlama bechor — baitliz hu dela mizdabban, ha beveteh mizdabban, ella maaser — beveteh mi mizdabban?
Vehatanya: bivchor neemar "lo tifde" venimkar chay, bemaaser neemar "lo yiggael" veeno nimkar, lo chay velo shachut, lo tam velo baal mum.
Ha milleta ikkashya leh lerav sheshet beureta, veshanneyay bekadmuta mibbarayyta, bemasar behema shel yetomim askinan, umishshum hashavat aveda nagu bah.

Rabbi idi sarseye derav sheshet hava shama minneh, azal amra be midresha vela amra mishshemeh, shema rav sheshet ikkefad, amar: man deaketz liketzeh akrabba, verav sheshet may nafka leh minna? deamar rav yehuda amar rav: may dichtiv "agura beoholcha olamim"? vechi ifshar leadam lagur bishne olamim?

Ella amar david: ribbono shel olam, yomru devar shemua mippi beolam hazze. deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: kol talmid chacham sheomrim devar shemua mippiv beolam hazze — siftotav dovvot bakkever.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak bar zeeri: may keraa — "vechikkech keyen hattov holech ledodi lemesharim dovev sifte yeshenim", kechomer shel anavim, ma komer shel anavim kevan deadam nogea bo – dovev, af talmide chachamim, kevan sheadam omer devar shemua mippiv – dovvot sefatav bakkever.
May barayyta? detanya: masar behema shel yetomim — mochrin oto, umasar behema sheshshechato — mavlio beoro, bechelbo, uvegido, uvekarnav.
May kaamar? amar abbaye: hachi kaamar — masar behema shel yetomim mochrin oto behavelaa.
Mikkelal degadol behavelaa la? may shena meha detanya: hallokeach lulav mechavero bishviit — noten lo etrog bemattana, lefi sheeno rashshay lelokcho bashsheviit.
Vehavenan bah: lo ratza litten lo bemattana may? veamar rav huna: mavlia lo deme etrog ballulav!
Hatam la mochcha milleta, hacha mochcha milleta.

Amar rava: im ken, "masar behema" tere zimne lema li? ella amar rava: hachi kaamar, masar behema shel yetomim mochrin oto kedarko, umasar behema degadol sheshshechato mavlio beoro bechelbo begido uvekarnav.
Amar rava: mena amena la? dichtiv: "vehaya hu utemurato yihye kodesh lo yiggael".
Ematay ose temura — mechayyim, ematay eno nigal — mechayyim, ha leachar shechita — nigal, verabbanan (hahu) [hu] digzaru leachar shechita, attu lifne shechita.
Davar hannishshom mechayyim — gezur rabbanan leachar shechita attu lifne shechita,
